original: na cātra karmādhikaraṇakarmāsti, kuṇḍe badarāṇīva | nāpy akarmādhikaraṇaṃ karmāsti karmābhāvatvād akarmaṇaḥ | ato viparītagṛhīte eva karmākarmaṇī laukikaiḥ, yathā mṛgatṛṣṇikāyām udakaṃ śuktikāyāṃ vā rajatam |

original: nanu karma karmaiva sarveṣāṃ na kvacid vyabhicarati | tan na nausthasya nāvi gacchantyāṃ taṭasthesv agatiṣu nageṣu pratikūlagatidarśanāt | dūreṣu cakṣuṣāsannikṛṣṭeṣu gacchatsu gatyabhāvadarśanāt |

original: evam ihāpy akarmaṇy ahaṃ karomīti karmadarśanaṃ karmaṇi cākarmadarśanaṃ viparītadarśanaṃ yena, tannirākaraṇārtham ucyate karmaṇy akarma yaḥ paśyet ity ādi |

original: tad etad uktaprativacanam apy asakṛd atyantaviparītadarśanabhāvitatayā momuhyamāno lokaḥ śrutam apy asakṛt tattvaṃ vismṛtya vismṛtya mithyāprasaṅgam avatāryāvatārya codayatīti punaḥ punar uttaram āha bhagavān | durvijñeyatvaṃ cālakṣya vastunaḥ |

original: avyakto 'yam acintyo 'yaṃ [Gītā 2.25], na jāyate mriyate [Gītā 2.27] ity ādinātmani karmābhāvaḥ śrutismṛtinyāyaprasiddha ukto vakṣyamāṇaś ca | tasminn ātmani karmābhāve 'karmaṇi karmaviparītadarśanam atyantanirūḍham | yataḥ kiṃ karma kim akarmeti kavayo 'py atra mohitāḥ [Gītā 4.16] dehādyāśrayaṃ karmātmany adhyāropya |

original: ahaṃ kartā mamaitat karma, mayāsya karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ bhoktavyam iti ca | tathā ahaṃ tūṣṇīṃ bhavāmi, yenāhaṃ nirāyāso 'karmā sukhī syām iti kāryakaraṇāśrayavyāpāroparamaṃ tatkṛtaṃ casukhitvam ātmany adhyāropya na karomi kiṃcit tūṣṇīṃ sukham āsam ity abhimanyate lokaḥ |
analyzed: aham kartā mama etat karma mayā asya karmaṇaḥ phalam bhoktavyam iti ca tathā aham tūṣṇīm bhavāmi yena aham sukhī syām iti kārya karaṇa āśraya vyāpāra uparamam tad kṛtam ca sukhi tvam ātmani adhyāropya na karomi kiṃcid tūṣṇīm sukham āsam iti abhimanyate lokaḥ

original: tatredaṃ lokasya viparītadarśanāpanayanāyāha bhagavān karmaṇy akarma yaḥ paśyed ity ādi |

original: atra ca karma karmaiva sat kāryakaraṇāśrayaṃ karmarahito 'vikriya ātmani sarvair adhyastam | yataḥ paṇḍito 'py ahaṃ karomīti manyate | atha ātmasamavetatayā sarvalokaprasiddhe karmaṇi nadīkulastheṣv iva gatiḥ pratilaumyena | ato 'karma karmābhāvaṃ yathābhūtaṃ gatyabhāvam iva vṛkṣeṣu yaḥ paśyet |

original: akarmaṇi ca kāryakaraṇavyāpāroparame karmavad ātmany adhyāropite tūṣṇīm akurvan sukham āse ity ahaṅkārābhisandhihetutvāt tasminn akarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ paśyet | ya evaṃ karmākarmavibhāgajñaḥ sa buddhimān paṇḍito manuṣyeṣu | sa yukto yogī kṛtsnakarmakṛc ca | so 'śubhān mokṣitaḥ kṛtakṛtyo bhavatīty arthaḥ |
analyzed: akarmaṇi ca kārya karaṇa vyāpāra uparame karma vat ātmani adhyāropite tūṣṇīm akurvan sukham āse iti ahaṅkāra abhisandhi hetu tvāt tasmin akarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ paśyet yaḥ evam karma akarma vibhāga jñaḥ sa buddhimān paṇḍitaḥ manuṣyeṣu sa yuktaḥ yogī kṛtsna karma kṛt ca saḥ śubhāt mokṣitaḥ kṛtakṛtyaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: ayaṃ śloko 'nyathā vyākhyātaḥ kaiścit | katham ? nityānāṃ kila karmaṇām īśvarārthe 'nuṣṭhīyamānānāṃ tatphalābhāvād akarmāṇi tāny ucyante gauṇyā vṛttyā | teṣāṃ cākaraṇam akarma | tac ca pratyavāyaphalatvāt karmocyate gauṇyaiva vṛttyā | tatra nitye karmaṇy akarma yaḥ paśyet phalābhāvāt |
analyzed: ayam ślokaḥ nyathā vyākhyātaḥ kaiścid katham nityānām kila karmaṇām īśvara arthe nuṣṭhīyamānānām tad phala abhāvāt akarmāṇi tāni ucyante gauṇyā vṛttyā teṣām ca akaraṇam akarma tat ca pratyavāya phala tvāt karma ucyate gauṇyā eva vṛttyā tatra nitye karmaṇi akarma yaḥ paśyet phala abhāvāt

original: yathā dhenur api gaur agaur ucyate kṣīrākhyaṃ phalaṃ na prayacchatīti tadvat | tathā nityākaraṇe tv akarmaṇi karmaḥ āśyen narakādipratyavāyaphalaṃ prayacchatīti | naitad yuktaṃ vyākhyānam | evaṃjñānād aśubhān mokṣānupapatteḥ | yaj jñātvā mokṣyase 'śubhāt [Gītā 4.16] iti bhagavatoktaṃ vacanaṃ bodhyeta |
analyzed: yathā dhenuḥ api gauḥ a gauḥ ucyate kṣīra ākhyam phalam na prayacchati iti tadvat tathā nitya akaraṇe tu akarmaṇi karmaḥ āśyet naraka ādi pratyavāya phalam prayacchati iti na etat yuktam vyākhyānam evam jñānāt aśubhāt mokṣa anupapatteḥ yat jñātvā mokṣyase śubhāt Gītā 416 iti bhagavatā uktam vacanam bodhyeta

original: katham ? nityānām anuṣṭhānād aśubhāt syān nāma mokṣaṇam | na tu teṣāṃ phalābhāvajñānāt | na hi nityānāṃ phalābhāvajñānam aśubhamuktiphalatvena coditaṃ nityakarmajñānaṃ vā | na ca bhagavativehoktam |
analyzed: katham nityānām anuṣṭhānāt aśubhāt syāt nāma mokṣaṇam na tu teṣām phala abhāva jñānāt na hi nityānām phala abhāva jñānam aśubha mukti phala tvena coditam nitya karma jñānam vā na ca

original: etenākarmaṇi karmadarśanaṃ pratyuktam | na hy akarmaṇi karmeti darśanaṃ kartavyatayeha codyate, nityasya tu kartavyatāmātram | na cākaraṇān nityasya pratyavāyo bhavatīti vijñānāt kiṃcit phalaṃ syāt | nāpi nityākaraṇaṃ jñeyatvena coditam | nāpi karmākarmeti mithādarśanād aśubhān mokṣaṇam |
analyzed: etena akarmaṇi karma darśanam pratyuktam na hi akarmaṇi karma iti darśanam kartavya tayā iha codyate nityasya tu kartavya tā mātram na ca akaraṇāt nityasya pratyavāyaḥ bhavati iti vijñānāt kiṃcid phalam syāt nā api nitya akaraṇam jñeya tvena coditam nā api karma akarma iti mithā darśanāt aśubhāt mokṣaṇam

original: buddhimattvaṃ, yuktatā, kṛtsnakarmakṛttvādi ca phalam upapadyate stutir vā | mithyājñānam eva hi sākṣād aśubharūpaṃ kuto 'nyasmād aśubhān mokṣaṇam ? na hi tamas tamaso nivartakaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: buddhimat tvam yukta tā kṛtsna karma kṛt tva ādi ca phalam upapadyate stutiḥ vā mithyājñānam eva hi sākṣāt aśubha rūpam kutas nyasmāt aśubhāt mokṣaṇam na hi tamaḥ tamasaḥ nivartakam bhavati

original: nanu karmaṇi yad akarmadarśanam akarmaṇi vā karmadarśanaṃ, na tanmithyājñānam | kiṃ tarhi gauṇaṃ phalabhāvābhāvanimittam ? na, karmākarmavijñānād api gauṇāt phalasyāśravaṇāt | nāpi śrutahānyaśrutaparikalpanayā kaścid viśeṣo labhyate | svaśabdenāpi śakyaṃ vaktuṃ nityakarmaṇāṃ phalaṃ nāsty akaraṇāc ca teṣāṃ narakapātaḥ syād iti |
analyzed: nanu karmaṇi yat akarma darśanam akarmaṇi vā karma darśanam na tat mithyājñānam kim tarhi gauṇam phala bhāva abhāva nimittam na karma akarma vijñānāt api gauṇāt phalasya aśravaṇāt na api śruta hāni aśruta parikalpanayā kaścid viśeṣaḥ labhyate sva śabdena api śakyam vaktum nitya karmaṇām phalam na asti akaraṇāt ca teṣām naraka pātaḥ syāt iti

original: tatra vyājena paravyāmoharūpeṇa karmaṇy akarma yaḥ paśyed ity ādinā kim ? tatraiva vyācakṣāṇena bhagavatoktaṃ vākyaṃ lokavyāmohārtham iti vyaktaṃ kalpitaṃ syāt | na caitac chadmarūpeṇa vākyena rakṣaṇīyaṃ vastu, nāpi śabdāntareṇa punaḥ punar ucyamānaṃ subodhaṃ syād ity evaṃ vaktuṃ yuktam |
analyzed: tatra vyājena para vyāmoha rūpeṇa karmaṇi akarma yaḥ paśyet iti ādinā kim tatra eva vyācakṣāṇena bhagavatā uktam vākyam loka vyāmoha artham iti vyaktam kalpitam syāt na ca etat chadma rūpeṇa vākyena rakṣaṇīyam vastu nā api śabda antareṇa punar punar ucyamānam su bodham syāt iti evam vaktum yuktam

original: karmaṇy evādhikāras te [Gītā 2.47] ity atra hi sphuṭatara ukto 'rtho na punar vaktavyo bhavati | sarvatra ca praśastaṃ boddhavyaṃ ca kartavyam eva, na niṣprayojanaṃ boddhavyam ity ucyate |
analyzed: karmaṇi eva adhikāraḥ te Gītā iti atra hi sphuṭataraḥ uktaḥ rthaḥ na punar vaktavyaḥ bhavati sarvatra ca praśastam boddhavyam ca kartavyam eva na niṣprayojanam boddhavyam iti ucyate

original: na ca mithyājñānaṃ boddhavyaṃ bhavati tatpratyupasthāpitaṃ vā vastvābhāsam | nāpi nityānām akaraṇād abhāvāt prayavāyabhāvotpattiḥ | nāsato vidyate bhāvo [Gītā 2.16] iti vacanāt | tatkatham asataḥ saj jāyate [ChāU 6.2.2] iti ca darśitam | asataḥ sajjanmapratiṣedhād asataḥ sadutpattiṃ bruvatā 'sad eva sad bhavet | sac cāsad bhaved ity uktaṃ syāt |
analyzed: na ca mithyājñānam boddhavyam bhavati tad pratyupasthāpitam vā vastu ābhāsam na api nityānām akaraṇāt abhāvāt prayavāya bhāva utpattiḥ na asataḥ vidyate bhāvaḥ Gītā 216 iti vacanāt tat katham asataḥ sat jāyate Cp Cp Cp Cp iti ca darśitam asataḥ sat janma pratiṣedhāt asataḥ sat utpattim bruvatā sat eva sat bhavet sat ca asat bhavet iti uktam syāt

original: tac cāyuktaṃ, sarvapramāṇavirodhāt | na ca niṣphalaṃ vidadhyāt karma śāstraṃ duḥkhasvarūpatvāt | duḥkhasya ca buddhipūrvakatayā kāryatvānupapatteḥ | tadakaraṇe ca narakapātābhyupagame 'narthāyaiva | ubhayathāpi karaṇe 'karaṇe ca śāstraṃ niṣphalaṃ kalpitaṃ syāt |
analyzed: tat ca ayuktam sarva pramāṇa virodhāt na ca niṣphalam vidadhyāt karma śāstram duḥkha svarūpa tvāt duḥkhasya ca buddhi pūrvaka tayā kāryatva anupapatteḥ tad akaraṇe ca naraka pāta abhyupagame narthāya eva ubhayathā api karaṇe karaṇe ca śāstram niṣphalam kalpitam syāt

original: svābhyupagamavirodhaś ca nityaṃ niṣphalaṃ karmety abhyupagamya mokṣaphalāyeti bruvataḥ | tasmād yathāśruta evārthaḥ karmaṇy akarma ya ity ādeḥ | tathā ca vyākhyāto 'smābhiḥ ślokaḥ ||BhGS_4.18||
analyzed: sva abhyupagama virodhaḥ ca nityam niṣphalam karma iti abhyupagamya mokṣa phalāya iti bruvataḥ tasmāt yathāśrutaḥ eva arthaḥ karmaṇi akarma yaḥ iti ādeḥ tathā ca vyākhyātaḥ smābhiḥ ślokaḥ SNM

original: tad etat karmaṇy akarmādidarśanaṃ stūyate
analyzed: tat etat karmaṇi a karma ādi darśanam stūyate

original: yasya sarve samārambhāḥ kāmasaṃkalpavarjitāḥ |
analyzed: yasya sarve samārambhāḥ kāma saṃkalpa varjitāḥ

original: jñānāgnidagdhakarmāṇaṃ tam āhuḥ paṇḍitaṃ budhāḥ ||BhG_4.19||
analyzed: jñāna agni dagdha karmāṇam tam āhuḥ paṇḍitam budhāḥ

original: yasya yathoktadarśinaḥ sarve yāvantaḥ samārambhāḥ karmāṇi samārabhyanta iti samārambhāḥ | kāmasaṃkalpavarjitāḥ kāmaistatkāraṇaiś ca saṅkalpavarjitā mudhaiva ceṣṭāmātrā anuṣṭhīyante |
analyzed: yasya yathā ukta darśinaḥ sarve yāvantaḥ samārambhāḥ karmāṇi samārabhyante iti samārambhāḥ kāma saṃkalpa varjitāḥ kāmaiḥ tad kāraṇaiḥ ca saṅkalpa varjitāḥ mudhā eva ceṣṭā mātrāḥ anuṣṭhīyante

original: pravṛttena cel lokasaṅgrahārthaṃ, nivṛttena cej jīvanamātrārthaṃ, taṃ jñānāgnidagdhakarmāṇaṃ karmādāv akarmādidarśanaṃ jñānaṃ, tad evāgnis tena jñānāgninā dagdhāni śubhāśubhalakṣaṇāni karmāṇi yasya | tam āhuḥ paramārthataḥ paṇḍitaṃ budhāḥ brahmavidaḥ ||BhGS_4.19||
analyzed: pravṛttena ced loka saṅgraha artham nivṛttena ced jīvana mātra artham tam jñāna agni dagdha karmāṇam karma ādau akarma ādi darśanam jñānam tat eva agniḥ tena jñāna agninā dagdhāni śubha aśubha lakṣaṇāni karmāṇi yasya tam āhuḥ paramārthataḥ paṇḍitam budhāḥ brahma vidaḥ PNM

original: yas tu karmādāv akarmādidarśī so 'karmādidarśanād eva niṣkarmā sannyāsī jīvanamātrārthaceṣṭaḥ san karmaṇi na pravartate, yadyapi prāgvivekataḥ pravṛttaḥ | yas tu prārabdhakarmā sann uttarakālam utpannātmasamyagdarśanaḥ syāt, sa sarvakarmaṇi prayojanam apaśyan sasādhanaṃ karma pariyajaty eva |
analyzed: yaḥ tu karma ādau akarma ādi darśī saḥ u karma ādi darśanāt eva niṣkarmā sannyāsī jīvana mātra artha ceṣṭaḥ san karmaṇi na pravartate yadi api prāc vivekataḥ pravṛttaḥ yaḥ tu prārabdha karmā san uttarakālam utpanna ātma samyak darśanaḥ syāt sa sarva karmaṇi prayojanam a paśyan sa sādhanam karma pariyajati eva

original: sa kutaścin nimittāt karmaparityāgāsambhave sati karmaṇi tatphale ca saṅgarahitatayā svaprayojanābhāvāl lokasaṅgrahārthaṃ pūrvavat karmaṇi pravṛtto 'pi naiva kiṃcit karoti jñānāgnidagdhakarmatvāt tadīyaṃ karmākarmaiva sampadyata ity etam arthaṃ darśayiṣyann āha
analyzed: sa kutaścid nimittāt karma parityāga asambhave sati karmaṇi tad phale ca saṅga rahita tayā sva prayojana abhāvāt loka saṅgraha artham pūrvavat karmaṇi na eva kiṃcid karoti jñāna agni dagdha karma tvāt tadīyam karma akarma eva sampadyate iti etam artham darśayiṣyan āha

original: tyaktvā karmaphalāsaṅgaṃ nityatṛpto nirāśrayaḥ |
analyzed: tyaktvā karma phala āsaṅgam nitya tṛptaḥ nirāśrayaḥ

original: karmaṇy abhipravṛtto 'pi naiva kiṃcit karoti saḥ ||BhG_4.20||
analyzed: karmaṇi na eva kiṃcid karoti saḥ

original: tyaktvā karmasv abhimānaṃ phalāsaṅgaṃ ca yathoktena jñānena nityatṛpto nirākāṅkṣo viṣayeṣv ity arthaḥ | nirāśraya āśrayarahitaḥ | āśrayo nāma yad āśritya puruṣārthaṃ sisādhayiṣati | dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalasādhanāśrayarahita ity arthaḥ | viduṣā kriyamāṇaṃ karma paramārthato 'karmaiva | tasya niṣkriyātmadarśanasampannatvāt |
analyzed: tyaktvā karmasu abhimānam phala āsaṅgam ca yathā uktena jñānena nitya tṛptaḥ nirākāṅkṣaḥ viṣayeṣu iti arthaḥ nirāśrayaḥ āśraya rahitaḥ āśrayaḥ nāma yat āśritya puruṣa artham sisādhayiṣati dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa phala sādhana āśraya rahitaḥ iti arthaḥ viduṣā kriyamāṇam karma karma eva tasya niṣkriya ātma darśana sampanna tvāt

original: tenaivambhūtena svaprayojanābhāvāt sasādhanaṃ karma parityaktavyam eveti prāpte, tato nirgamāsambhavāl lokasaṅgrahacikīrṣayā śiṣṭavigarhaṇāparijihīrṣayā vā pūrvavat karmaṇyabhipravṛtto 'pi niṣkryātmadarśanasampannatvān naiva kiṃcit karoti saḥ ||BhGS_4.20||
analyzed: tena evambhūtena sva prayojana abhāvāt sa sādhanam karma parityaktavyam eva iti prāpte tatas nirgama asambhavāt loka saṅgraha cikīrṣayā śiṣṭa vigarhaṇā parijihīrṣayā vā pūrvavat karmaṇi abhipravṛttaḥ upi niṣkryā ātma darśana sampanna tvāt na eva kiṃcid karoti saḥ SNM

original: yaḥ punaḥ pūrvoktaviparītaḥ prāg eva karmāmbhād brahmaṇi sarvāntare pratyagātmani niṣkriye saṃjātātmadarśanaḥ, sa dṛṣṭādṛṣṭeṣṭaviṣayāśīr vivarjitatayā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthe karmaṇi prayojanam apyaśyan sasādhanaṃ karma saṃnyasya śarīrayātrāmātraceṣṭo yatir jñānaniṣṭho mucyata iti | etad arthaṃ darśayitum āha
analyzed: yaḥ punar pūrva ukta viparītaḥ prāk eva karma ambhāt brahmaṇi sarva antare pratyagātmani niṣkriye saṃjāta ātma darśanaḥ sa dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa iṣṭa viṣaya āśīḥ vivarjita tayā dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa arthe karmaṇi prayojanam api aśyan sa sādhanam karma saṃnyasya śarīra yātrā mātra ceṣṭaḥ yatiḥ jñāna niṣṭhaḥ mucyate iti etat artham darśayitum āha

original: nirāśīr yatacittātmā tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ |
analyzed: nirāśīḥ yata citta ātmā tyakta sarva parigrahaḥ

original: śārīraṃ kevalaṃ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣam ||BhG_4.21||
analyzed: śārīram kevalam karma kurvan na āpnoti kilbiṣam

original: nirāśīr nirgatā āśiṣo yasmāt sa nirāśīḥ | yatacittātmā cittam antaḥkaraṇam | ātmā bāhyaḥ kāryakaraṇasaṃghātaḥ | tāv ubhāv api yatau saṃyatau yasya sa yatacittātmā | tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ  tyaktaḥ sarvaḥ parigraho yena sa tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ | śārīraṃ śarīrasthitimātraprayojanaṃ kevalaṃ tatrāpi abhimānavarjitaṃ karma kurvan |
analyzed: nirāśīḥ nirgatāḥ āśiṣaḥ yasmāt sa nirāśīḥ yata citta ātmā cittam antaḥkaraṇam ātmā bāhyaḥ kārya karaṇa saṃghātaḥ tau ubhau api yatau saṃyatau yasya sa yata citta ātmā tyakta sarva parigrahaḥ tyaktaḥ sarvaḥ parigrahaḥ yena sa tyakta sarva parigrahaḥ śārīram śarīra sthiti mātra prayojanam kevalam tatra api abhimāna varjitam karma kurvan

original: nāpnoti na prāpnoti kilbiṣam aniṣṭarūpaṃ pāpaṃ dharmaṃ ca | dharmo 'pi mumukṣor aniṣṭarūpaṃ kilbiṣam eva | bandhāpādakatvāt | tasmāt tābhyāṃ mukto bhavati, saṃsārān mukto bhavatīty arthaḥ |
analyzed: na āpnoti na prāpnoti kilbiṣam aniṣṭa rūpam pāpam dharmam ca mumukṣoḥ aniṣṭa rūpam kilbiṣam eva bandha āpādaka tvāt tasmāt tābhyām muktaḥ bhavati saṃsārāt muktaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: kiṃ ca śārīraṃ kevalaṃ karmety atra kiṃ śarīranirvartyaṃ śārīraṃ karmābhipretam ? āho svic charīrasthitimātraprayojanaṃ śārīraṃ karma ? iti | kiṃ cāto yadi śarīranirvartyaṃ śārīraṃ karma yadi vā śarīrasthitimātraprayojanaṃ śarīram ? iti |
analyzed: kim ca śārīram kevalam karma iti atra kim śarīra nirvartyam śārīram karma abhipretam āho svid śarīra sthiti mātra prayojanam śārīram karma iti kim ca atas yadi śarīra nirvartyam śārīram karma yadi vā śarīra sthiti mātra prayojanam śarīram iti

original: ucyate  yadā śarīranirvartyaṃ karma śārīram abhipretaṃ syāt tadā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaprayojanaṃ karma pratiṣiddham api śarīreṇa kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣam iti bruvato viruddhābhidhānaṃ prasajyeta | śāstrīyaṃ ca karma dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaprayojanaṃ śarīreṇa kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣam ity api bruvato 'prāptapratiṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: ucyate yadā śarīra nirvartyam karma śārīram abhipretam syāt tadā dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa prayojanam karma pratiṣiddham api śarīreṇa kurvan na āpnoti kilbiṣam iti bruvataḥ viruddha abhidhānam prasajyeta śāstrīyam ca karma dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa prayojanam śarīreṇa kurvan na āpnoti kilbiṣam iti api bruvataḥ prāpta pratiṣedha prasaṅgaḥ

original: śārīraṃ karma kurvan iti viśeṣaṇāt kevalaśabdaprayogāc ca vāṅmanasanirvartyaṃ karma vidhipratiṣedhaviṣayaṃ dharmādharmaśabdavācyaṃ kurvan prāpnoti kilbiṣam ity uktaṃ syāt |
analyzed: śārīram karma kurvan iti viśeṣaṇāt kevala śabda prayogāt ca vāc manasa nirvartyam karma vidhi pratiṣedha viṣayam dharma adharma śabda vācyam kurvan prāpnoti kilbiṣam iti uktam syāt

original: tatrāpi vāṅmanasābhyāṃ vihitānuṣṭhānapakṣe kilbiṣaprāptivacanaṃ viruddham āpadyeta | pratiṣiddhasevipakṣe 'pi bhūtārthānuvādamātram anarthakaṃ syāt |
analyzed: tatra api vāc manasābhyām vihita anuṣṭhāna pakṣe kilbiṣa prāpti vacanam viruddham āpadyeta pratiṣiddha sevi pakṣe bhūta artha anuvāda mātram anarthakam syāt

original: yadā tu śarīrasthitimātraprayojanaṃ śārīraṃ karmābhipretaṃ bhavet, tadā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaprayojanaṃ karma vidhipratiṣedhagamyaṃ śarīravāṅmanasanirvartyam anyad akruvaṃs tair eva śarīrādibhiḥ śarīrasthitimātraprayojanaṃ kevalaśabdaprayogāt ahaṃ karomi ity abhimānavarjitaḥ śarīrādiceṣṭāmātraṃ lokadṛṣṭyā kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣam |
analyzed: yadā tu śarīra sthiti mātra prayojanam śārīram karma abhipretam bhavet tadā dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa prayojanam karma vidhi pratiṣedha gamyam śarīra vāc manasa nirvartyam anyat akruvan taiḥ eva śarīra ādibhiḥ śarīra sthiti mātra prayojanam kevala śabda prayogāt aham karomi iti abhimāna varjitaḥ śarīra ādi ceṣṭā mātram loka dṛṣṭyā kurvan na āpnoti kilbiṣam

original: evambhūtasya pāpaśabdavācyakilbiṣaprāptyasambhavāt kilbiṣaṃ saṃsāraṃ nāpnoti | jñānāgnidagdhasarvakarmatvād apratibandhena mucyate eveti pūrvoktasamyagdarśanaphalānuvāda evaiṣaḥ | evaṃ śarīraṃ kevalaṃ karma ity asyārthasya parigrahe niravadyaṃ bhavati ||BhGS_4.21||

original: nanu avidyāvattvam eva kṣetrajñasya saṃsāritvadoṣaḥ | tatkṛtaṃ ca sukhitvaduḥkhitvādi pratyakṣam upalabhyate iti cet, na | jñeyasya kṣetradharmatvāt, jñātuḥ kṣetrajñasya tatkṛtadoṣānupapatteḥ | yāvat kiṃcit kṣetrajñasya doṣajātam avidyamānam āsañjayasi, tasya jñeyatvopapatteḥ kṣetradharmatvam eva, na kṣetrajñadharmatvam |
analyzed: nanu avidyāvat tvam eva kṣetrajñasya saṃsāri tva doṣaḥ tad kṛtam ca sukhi tva duḥkhi tva ādi pratyakṣam upalabhyate iti ced na jñeyasya kṣetra dharma tvāt jñātuḥ kṣetrajñasya tad kṛta doṣa anupapatteḥ yāvat kiṃcid kṣetrajñasya doṣa jātam avidyamānam āsañjayasi tasya jñeya tva upapatteḥ kṣetra dharma tvam eva na kṣetrajña dharma tvam

original: na ca tena kṣetrajño duṣyati, jñeyena jñātuḥ saṃsargānupapatteḥ | yadi hi saṃsargaḥ syāt, jñeyatvam eva nopapadyeta | yady ātmano dharmo 'vidyāvattvaṃ duḥkhitvādi ca kathaṃ bhoḥ pratyakṣam upalabhyate | kathaṃ vā kṣetrajñadharmaḥ |

original: jñeyaṃ ca sarvaṃ kṣetraṃ jñātaiva kṣetrajña ity avadhārite, avidyāduḥkhitvādeḥ kṣetrajñaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ kṣetrajñadharmatvaṃ tasya ca pratyakṣopalabhyatvam iti viruddham ucyate 'vidyāmātrāvaṣṭambhāt kevalam ||

original: atrāha  sāvidyā kasya ? iti | yasya dṛśyate tasyaiva | kasya dṛśyate ? iti | atrocyate  avidyā kasya dṛśyate iti praśno nirarthakaḥ | katham ? dṛśyate ced avidyā, tadvantam api paśyasi | na ca tadvaty upalabhyamāne sā kasya ? iti praśno yuktaḥ | na hi gomati upalabhyamāne gāvaḥ kasya ? iti praśno 'rthavān bhavati |
analyzed: atra āha sā avidyā kasya iti yasya dṛśyate tasya eva kasya dṛśyate iti atra ucyate avidyā kasya dṛśyate iti praśnaḥ nirarthakaḥ katham dṛśyate ced avidyā tadvantam api paśyasi na ca tadvati upalabhyamāne sā kasya iti praśnaḥ yuktaḥ na hi gomati upalabhyamāne gāvaḥ kasya iti praśnaḥ rthavān bhavati

original: nanu viṣamo dṛṣṭāntaḥ | gavāṃ tadvataś ca pratyakṣatvāt tatsaṃbandho 'pi pratyakṣa iti praśno nirarthakaḥ | na tathāvidyā tadvāṃś ca pratyakṣau, yataḥ praśno nirarthakaḥ syāt | apratyakṣeṇāvidyāvatāvidyāsaṃbandhe jñāte, kiṃ tava syāt ? avidyāyā anarthahetutvāt parihartavyā syāt | yasyāvidyā, sa tāṃ parihariṣyati |
analyzed: nanu viṣamaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ gavām tadvataḥ ca pratyakṣa tvāt tad saṃbandhaḥ pi pratyakṣaḥ iti praśnaḥ nirarthakaḥ na tathā avidyā tadvān ca pratyakṣau yatas praśnaḥ nirarthakaḥ syāt apratyakṣeṇa avidyāvatā avidyā saṃbandhe jñāte kim tava syāt avidyāyāḥ anartha hetu tvāt parihartavyā syāt yasya avidyā sa tām parihariṣyati

original: nanu mamaivāvidyā | jānāsi tarhy avidyāṃ tadvantaṃ ca ātmānam | jānāmi, na tu pratyakṣeṇa | anumānenaś cej jānāsi, kathaṃ saṃbandhagrahaṇam ? na hi tava jñātuḥ jñeyabhūtayāvidyayā tatkāle saṃbandho grahītuṃ śakyate, avidyāyā viṣayatvenaiva jñātur upayuktatvāt | na ca jñātur avidyāyā ca saṃbandhasya yo grahītā, jñānaṃ cānyat tadviṣayaṃ saṃbhavati |
analyzed: nanu mama eva avidyā jānāsi tarhi avidyām tadvantam ca ātmānam jānāmi na tu pratyakṣeṇa anumānenaḥ ced jānāsi katham saṃbandha grahaṇam na hi tava jñātuḥ jñeya bhūtayā avidyayā tad kāle saṃbandhaḥ grahītum śakyate avidyāyāḥ viṣaya tvena eva jñātuḥ upayukta tvāt na ca jñātuḥ avidyāyāḥ ca saṃbandhasya yaḥ grahītā jñānam ca anyat tad viṣayam saṃbhavati

original: anavasthāprāpteḥ | yadi jñātrāpi jñeyasaṃbandho jñāyate, anyo jñātā kalpyaḥ syāt, tasyāpy anyaḥ, tasyāpy anyaḥ ity anavasthāparihāryā | yadi punar avidyā jñeyā, anyad vā jñeyaṃ jñeyam eva | tathā jñātāpi jñātaiva, na jñeyaṃ bhavati | yadā caivam, avidyāduḥkhitvādyair na jñātuḥ kṣetrajñasya kiṃcit duṣyati ||
analyzed: anavasthā prāpteḥ yadi jñātrā api jñeya saṃbandhaḥ jñāyate anyaḥ jñātā kalpyaḥ syāt tasya api anyaḥ tasya api anyaḥ iti anavasthā parihāryā yadi punar avidyā jñeyā anyat vā jñeyam jñeyam eva tathā jñātā api jñātā eva na jñeyam bhavati yadā ca evam avidyā duḥkhi tva ādyaiḥ na jñātuḥ kṣetrajñasya kiṃcid duṣyati

original: nanu ayam eva doṣaḥ, yat doṣavatkṣetravijñātṛtvam | na ca vijñānasvarūpasyaivāvikriyasya vijñātṛtvopacārāt | yathoṣṇatāmātreṇāgnes taptikriyopacāraḥ, tadvat | yathātra bhagavatā kriyākārakaphalātmatvābhāva ātmani svata eva darśitaḥ  avidyādhyāropita eva kriyākārakādir ātmany upacaryate |

original: tathā tatra tatra ya enaṃ vetti hantāram [Gītā 2.19], prakṛteḥ kriyamāṇāni guṇaiḥ karmāṇi sarvaśaḥ [Gītā 3.27], nādatte kasyacit pāpam [Gītā 5.15] ity ādiprakaraṇeṣu darśitaḥ | tathaiva ca vyākhyātam asmābhiḥ | uttareṣu ca prakaraṇeṣu darśayiṣyāmaḥ ||

original: puruṣaś ca saṃsārasya kāraṇaṃ yathā syāt tad ucyate  puruṣo jīvaḥ kṣetrajño bhoktā iti paryāyaḥ, sukhaduḥkhānāṃ bhogyānāṃ bhoktṛtve upalabdhṛtve hetur ucyate |

original: kathaṃ punar anena kāryakaraṇakartṛtvena sukhaduḥkhabhoktṛtvena ca prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ saṃsārakāraṇatvam ucyate ? ity atrocyate  kāryakaraṇasukhaduḥkharūpeṇa hetuphalātmanā prakṛteḥ pariṇāmābhāve, puruṣasya ca cetanasyāsati tadupalabdhṛtve, kutaḥ saṃsāraḥ syāt ? yadā punaḥ kāryakaraṇasukhaduḥkhasvarūpeṇa hetuphalātmanā pariṇatayā prakṛtyā bhogyayā

original: yat ādityagatam ādityāśrayam | kiṃ tat ? tejo dīptiḥ prakāśo jagad bhāsayate prakāśayaty akhilaṃ samastam | yac candramasi śaśabhṛti tejo 'vabhāsakaṃ vartate, yac cāgnau hutavahe, tat tejo viddhi vijānīhi māmakaṃ madīyaṃ mama viṣṇos taj jyotiḥ |
analyzed: yat āditya gatam āditya āśrayam kim tat tejaḥ dīptiḥ prakāśaḥ jagat bhāsayate prakāśayati akhilam samastam yat candramasi śaśabhṛti tejaḥ vabhāsakam vartate yat ca agnau hutavahe tat tejaḥ viddhi vijānīhi māmakam madīyam mama viṣṇoḥ tat jyotiḥ

original: athavā, ādityagataṃ tejaś caitanyātmakaṃ jyotir yac candramasi, yac cāgnau vartate tat tejo viddhi māmakaṃ madīyaṃ mama viṣṇos taj jyotiḥ |
analyzed: athavā āditya gatam tejaḥ caitanya ātmakam jyotiḥ yat candramasi yat ca agnau vartate tat tejaḥ viddhi māmakam madīyam mama viṣṇoḥ tat jyotiḥ

original: nanu sthāvareṣu jaṅgameṣu ca tat samānaṃ caitanyātmakaṃ jyotiḥ | tatra katham idaṃ viśeṣaṇam  yad ādityagatam ity ādi | naiṣa doṣaḥ, sattvādhikyād vistaratvopapatteḥ | ādityādiṣu hi sattvam atyantaprakāśam atyantabhāsvaram | atas tatraivāvistaraṃ jyotir iti tad viśiṣyate, na tu tatraiva tad adhikam iti |
analyzed: nanu sthāvareṣu jaṅgameṣu ca tat samānam caitanya ātmakam jyotiḥ tatra katham idam viśeṣaṇam yat āditya gatam iti ādi na eṣa doṣaḥ sattva ādhikyāt vistara tva upapatteḥ āditya ādiṣu hi sattvam atyanta prakāśam atyanta bhāsvaram atas tatra eva a vistaram jyotiḥ iti tat viśiṣyate na tu tatra eva tat adhikam iti

original: yathā hi loke tulye 'pi mukhasaṃsthāne na kāṣṭhakuḍyādau mukham āvirbhavati, ādarśādau tu svacche svacchatare ca tāratamyenāvirbhavati, tadvat ||BhGS_15.12||

original: gāṃ pṛthivīm āviśya praviśya dhārayāmi bhūtāni jagad aham ojasā balena | yad balaṃ kāmarāgavivarjitam aiśvaraṃ rūpaṃ jagadvidhāraṇāya pṛthivyām praviṣṭaṃ yena pṛthivī gurvī nādhaḥ patati na vidīryate ca | tathā ca mantravarṇaḥ  yena dyaur ugrā pṛthivī ca dṛḍhā [TaittS 4.1.8] iti, sa dādhāra pṛthivīm [R̥k 8.7.3.1] ity ādiś ca |
analyzed: gām pṛthivīm āviśya praviśya dhārayāmi bhūtāni jagat aham ojasā balena yat balam kāma rāga vivarjitam aiśvaram rūpam jagat vidhāraṇāya pṛthivyām praviṣṭam yena pṛthivī gurvī na adhas patati na vidīryate ca tathā ca mantra varṇaḥ yena dyauḥ ugrā pṛthivī ca dṛḍhā Taittiri SVM iti sa dādhāra pṛthivīm R̥k 8731 iti ādiḥ ca

original: ato gām āviśya ca bhūtāni carācarāṇi dhārayāmīti yuktam uktam | kiṃ ca, pṛthivyāṃ jātā oṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ vrīhiyavādyāḥ puṣṇāmi puṣṭimatīḥ rasasvādumatī ca karomi somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ somaḥ san rasātmakaḥ rasasvabhāvaḥ | sarvarasānām ākaraḥ somaḥ | sa hi sarvarasātmakaḥ sarvāḥ oṣadhīḥ svātmarasān anupraveśayan puṣṇāti ||BhGS_15.13||
analyzed: atas gām āviśya ca bhūtāni cara acarāṇi dhārayāmi iti yuktam uktam kim ca pṛthivyām jātāḥ oṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ vrīhi yava ādyāḥ puṣṇāmi puṣṭimatīḥ rasa svādumatī ca karomi somaḥ bhūtvā rasa ātmakaḥ somaḥ san rasa ātmakaḥ rasa svabhāvaḥ sarva rasānām ākaraḥ somaḥ sa hi sarva rasa ātmakaḥ sarvāḥ oṣadhīḥ sva ātma rasān anupraveśayan puṣṇāti SPr3In

original: vaiśvānaraḥ san prāṇināṃ prāṇavatāṃ deham āśritaḥ praviṣṭaḥ prāṇāpānasamāyuktaḥ prāṇāpānābhyāṃ samāyuktaḥ saṃyuktaḥ pacāmi paṅkti karomy annam aśanaṃ caturvidhaṃ catuṣprakāraṃ bhojyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyaṃ ca | bhoktā vai vānaro 'gniḥ | agner bhojyam annaṃ somaḥ | tad etad ubhayam agnīṣomau sarvam iti paśyato 'nnadoṣalepo na bhavati ||BhGS_15.14||

original: sarvasya ca prāṇijātasyāham ātmā san hṛdi buddhau saṃniviṣṭaḥ | ato matta ātmanaḥ sarvaprāṇināṃ smṛtir jñānaṃ tadapohanaṃ cāpagamanaṃ ca | yeṣāṃ yathā puṇyakarmaṇāṃ puṇyakarmānurodhena jñānasmṛtī bhavataḥ, tathā pāpakarmaṇāṃ pāpakarmānurūpeṇa smṛtijñānayor apohanaṃ cāpāyanam apagamanaṃ ca | vedaiś ca sarvair aham eva paramātmā vedyo veditavyaḥ |

original: bhagavata īśvarasya nārāyaṇākhyasya vibhūtisaṃkṣepa ukto viśiṣṭopādhikṛto yad ādityagataṃ tejaḥ [Gītā 15.12] ity ādinā | athādhunā tasyaiva kṣarākṣaropādhipravibhaktatayā nirupādhikasya kevalasya tattvasvarūpanirdidhārayiṣayottaraślokā ārabhyante | tatra sarvam evātītān āgatān antarādhyāyārthajātaṃ tridhā rāśīkṛtya āha

original: ataḥ te na kāyakleśaduḥkhabhayāt karma parityajanti. nāpi te karmāṇi ātmani paśyanti, yena niyataṃ karma mohāt parityajeyuḥ. guṇānāṃ karma 'naiva kiñcitkaromi' iti hi te saṃnyasyanti. 'sarvakarmāṇi manasā saṃnyasya (gītā 5.13)' ityādibhiḥ tattvavidaḥ saṃnyāsaprakāraḥ uktaḥ.
analyzed: atas te na kāya kleśa duḥkha bhayāt karma parityajanti na api te karmāṇi ātmani paśyanti yena niyatam karma mohāt parityajeyuḥ guṇānām karma na eva kiñcid karomi iti hi te saṃnyasyanti sarva karmāṇi manasā saṃnyasya gītā ityādibhiḥ tattva vidaḥ saṃnyāsa prakāraḥ uktaḥ

original: tasmāt ye anye adhikṛtāḥ karmaṇi anātmavidaḥ, yeṣāṃ ca mohanimittaḥ tyāgaḥ saṃbhavati kāyakleśabhayācca, te eva tāmasāḥ tyāginaḥ rājasāśca iti nindyante karmiṇām anātmajñānāṃ karmaphalatyāgastutyartham; 'sarvārambhaparityāgī (gītā 14.25)' 'maunī saṃtuṣṭo yena kenacit (gītā 12.19).
analyzed: tasmāt ye anye adhikṛtāḥ karmaṇi anātma vidaḥ yeṣām ca moha nimittaḥ tyāgaḥ saṃbhavati kāya kleśa bhayāt ca te eva tāmasāḥ tyāginaḥ rājasāḥ ca iti nindyante karmiṇām anātma jñānām karma phala tyāga stuti artham sarva ārambha parityāgī gītā 1425 maunī saṃtuṣṭaḥ yena kenacid gītā

original: aniketaḥ sthiramatiḥ (gītā 12.19)' iti guṇātītalakṣaṇe ca paramārthasaṃnyāsinaḥ viśeṣitatvāt. vakṣyati ca 'niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā (gītā 18.50)' iti. tasmāt jñānaniṣṭhāḥ saṃnyāsinaḥ na iha vivakṣitāḥ. karmaphalatyāgaḥ eva sāttvikatvena guṇena tāmasatvādyapekṣayā saṃnyāsaḥ ucyate, na mukhyaḥ sarvakarmasaṃnyāsaḥ..
analyzed: aniketaḥ sthira matiḥ gītā iti guṇa atīta lakṣaṇe ca paramārtha saṃnyāsinaḥ viśeṣita tvāt vakṣyati ca niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā gītā iti tasmāt jñāna niṣṭhāḥ saṃnyāsinaḥ na iha vivakṣitāḥ karma phala tyāgaḥ eva sāttvika tvena guṇena tāmasa tva ādi apekṣayā saṃnyāsaḥ ucyate na mukhyaḥ sarva karma saṃnyāsaḥ

original: sarvakarmasaṃnyāsāsaṃbhave ca 'na hi dehabhṛtā' iti hetuvacanāt mukhya eva iti cet, na; hetuvacanasya stutyarthatvāt. yathā tyāgācchāntiranantaram (gītā 12.12)' iti karmaphalatyāgastutireva yathoktānekapakṣānuṣṭhānāśaktimantam arjunam ajñaṃ prati vidhānāt; tathā idamapi 'na hi dehabhṛtā śakyam (gītā 18.11)' iti karmaphalatyāgastutyartham;
analyzed: sarva karma saṃnyāsa asaṃbhave ca na hi dehabhṛtā iti hetu vacanāt mukhyaḥ eva iti ced na hetu vacanasya stuti artha tvāt yathā tyāgāt śāntiḥ anantaram gītā iti karma phala tyāga stutiḥ eva yathā ukta aneka pakṣa anuṣṭhāna aśaktimantam arjunam ajñam prati vidhānāt tathā idam api na hi dehabhṛtā śakyam gītā 1811 iti karma phala tyāga stuti artham

original: na 'sarvakarmāṇi manasā saṃnyasya naiva kurvanna kārayannāste' ityasya pakṣasya apavādaḥ kenacit darśayituṃ śakyaḥ. tasmāt karmaṇi adhikṛtān pratyeva eṣaḥ saṃnyāsatyāgavikalpaḥ. ye tu paramārthadarśinaḥ sāṃkhyāḥ, teṣāṃ jñānaniṣṭhāyāmeva sarvakarmasaṃnyāsalakṣaṇāyām adhikāraḥ, na anyatra, iti na te vikalpārhāḥ.
analyzed: na sarva karmāṇi manasā saṃnyasya na eva kurvan na kārayan āste iti asya pakṣasya apavādaḥ kenacid darśayitum śakyaḥ tasmāt karmaṇi adhikṛtān prati eva eṣaḥ saṃnyāsa tyāga vikalpaḥ ye tu parama artha darśinaḥ sāṃkhyāḥ teṣām jñāna niṣṭhāyām eva sarva karma saṃnyāsa lakṣaṇāyām adhikāraḥ na anyatra iti na te vikalpa arhāḥ

original: tacca upapāditam asmābhiḥ 'vedāvināśinam (gītā 2.21)' ityasminpradeśe, tṛtīyādau ca..
analyzed: tat ca upapāditam asmābhiḥ veda avināśinam gītā iti asmin pradeśe tṛtīya ādau ca

original: tatra eteṣu vikalpabhedeṣu
analyzed: tatra eteṣu vikalpa bhedeṣu

original: niścayaṃ śrṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama.
analyzed: niścayam śrṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharata sattama

original: tyāgo hi puruṣavyāghra trividhaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ..18.4..
analyzed: tyāgaḥ hi puruṣa vyāghra trividhaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ

original: niścayaṃ śrṛṇu avadhāraya me mama vacanāt; tatra tyāge tyāgasaṃnyāsavikalpe yathādarśite bharatasattama bharatānāṃ sādhutama. tyāgo hi, tyāgasaṃnyāsaśabdavācyo hi yaḥ arthaḥ saḥ eka eveti abhipretya āha  tyāgo hi iti.
analyzed: niścayam śrṛṇu avadhāraya me mama vacanāt tatra tyāge tyāga saṃnyāsa vikalpe yathā darśite bharata sattama bharatānām sādhutama tyāgaḥ hi tyāga saṃnyāsa śabda vācyaḥ hi yaḥ arthaḥ saḥ ekaḥ eva iti abhipretya āha tyāgaḥ hi iti

original: puruṣavyāghra, trividhaḥ triprakāraḥ tāmasādiprakāraiḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ śāstreṣu samyak kathitaḥ yasmāt tāmasādibhedena tyāgasaṃnyāsaśabdavācyaḥ arthaḥ adhikṛtasya karmiṇaḥ anātmajñasya trividhaḥ saṃbhavati, na paramārthadarśinaḥ, ityayamarthaḥ durjñānaḥ, tasmāt atra tattvaṃ na anyaḥ vaktuṃ samarthaḥ.
analyzed: puruṣa vyāghra trividhaḥ tri prakāraḥ tāmasa ādi prakāraiḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ śāstreṣu samyak kathitaḥ yasmāt tāmasa ādi bhedena tyāga saṃnyāsa śabda vācyaḥ arthaḥ adhikṛtasya karmiṇaḥ anātma jñasya trividhaḥ saṃbhavati na parama artha darśinaḥ iti ayam arthaḥ durjñānaḥ tasmāt atra tattvam na anyaḥ vaktum samarthaḥ

original: tasmāt niścayaṃ paramārthaśāstrārthaviṣayam adhyavasāyam aiśvaraṃ me mattaḥ śrṛṇu..
analyzed: tasmāt niścayam parama artha śāstra artha viṣayam adhyavasāyam aiśvaram me mattaḥ śrṛṇu

original: kaḥ punaḥ asau niścayaḥ iti, āha
analyzed: kaḥ punar asau niścayaḥ iti āha

original: yajñadānatapaḥkarma na tyājyaṃ kāryameva tat.
analyzed: yajña dāna tapaḥ karma na tyājyam kāryam eva tat

original: yajño dānaṃ tapaścaiva pāvanāni manīṣiṇām..18.5..
analyzed: yajñaḥ dānam tapaḥ ca eva pāvanāni manīṣiṇām

original: yajñaḥ dānaṃ tapaḥ ityetat trividhaṃ karma na tyājyaṃ na tyaktavyam, kāryaṃ karaṇīyam eva tat. kasmāt? yajñaḥ dānaṃ tapaścaiva pāvanāni viśuddhikarāṇi manīṣiṇāṃ phalānabhisaṃdhīnām ityetat..
analyzed: yajñaḥ dānam tapaḥ iti etat trividham karma na tyājyam na tyaktavyam kāryam karaṇīyam eva tat kasmāt yajñaḥ dānam tapaḥ ca eva pāvanāni viśuddhi karāṇi manīṣiṇām phala an abhisaṃdhīnām iti etat

original: etānyapi tu karmāṇi saṅagaṃ tyaktvā phalāni ca.
analyzed: etāni api tu karmāṇi saṅagam tyaktvā phalāni ca

original: kartavyānīti me pārtha niśicataṃ matamuttamam..18.6..
analyzed: kartavyāni iti me pārtha niśi catam matam uttamam

original: etānyapi tu karmāṇi yajñadānatapāṃsi pāvanāni uktāni saṅagam āsaktiṃ teṣu tyaktvā phalāni ca teṣāṃ parityajya kartavyāni iti anuṣṭheyāni iti me mama niścitaṃ matam uttamam..
analyzed: etāni api tu karmāṇi yajña dāna tapāṃsi pāvanāni uktāni saṅagam āsaktim teṣu tyaktvā phalāni ca teṣām parityajya kartavyāni iti anuṣṭheyāni iti me mama niścitam matam uttamam

original: 'niścayaṃ śṛṇu me tatra (gītā 18.4)' iti pratijñāya, pāvanatvaṃ ca hetum uktvā, 'etānyapi karmāṇi kartavyāni' ityetat 'niścitaṃ matamuttamam' iti pratijñātārthopasaṃhāra eva, na apūrvārthaṃ vacanam, 'etānyapi' iti prakṛtasaṃnikṛṣṭārthatvopapatteḥ. sāsaṅagasya phalārthinaḥ bandhahetavaḥ etānyapi karmāṇi mumukṣoḥ kartavyāni iti apiśabdasya arthaḥ.
analyzed: niścayam śṛṇu me tatra gītā iti pratijñāya pāvana tvam ca hetum uktvā etāni api karmāṇi kartavyāni iti etat niścitam matam uttamam iti pratijñāta artha upasaṃhāraḥ eva na apūrva artham vacanam etāni api iti prakṛta saṃnikṛṣṭa artha tva upapatteḥ sāsaṅagasya phala arthinaḥ bandha hetavaḥ etāni api karmāṇi mumukṣoḥ kartavyāni iti apiśabdasya arthaḥ

original: na tu anyāni karmāṇi apekṣya 'etānyapi' iti ucyate..
analyzed: na tu anyāni karmāṇi apekṣya etāni api iti ucyate

original: anye tu varṇayanti  nityānāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalābhāvāt 'saṅagaṃ tyaktvā phalāni ca' iti na upapadyate. ataḥ 'etānyapi' iti yāni kāmyāni karmāṇi nityebhyaḥ anyāni, etāni api kartavyāni, kimuta yajñadānatapāṃsi nityāni iti. tat asat, nityānāmapi karmaṇām iha phalavattvasya upapāditatvāt 'yajño dānaṃ tapaścaiva pāvanāni (gītā 18.5)' ityādinā vacanena.
analyzed: anye tu varṇayanti nityānām karmaṇām phala abhāvāt saṅagam tyaktvā phalāni ca iti na upapadyate atas etāni api iti yāni kāmyāni karmāṇi nityebhyaḥ anyāni etāni api kartavyāni kim uta yajña dāna tapāṃsi nityāni iti tat asat nityānām api karmaṇām iha phalavat tvasya upapādita tvāt yajñaḥ dānam tapaḥ ca eva pāvanāni gītā ityādinā vacanena

original: nityānyapi karmāṇi bandhahetutvāśaṅakayā jihāsoḥ mumukṣoḥ kutaḥ kāmyeṣu prasaṅagaḥ? 'dūreṇa hyavaraṃ karma (gītā 2.49)' iti ca ninditatvāt, 'yajñārthāt karmaṇo'nyatra (gītā 3.9)' iti ca kāmyakarmaṇāṃ bandhahetutvasya niścitatvāt, 'traiguṇyaviṣayā vedāḥ (gītā 2.45)' 'traividyā māṃ somapāḥ (gītā 9.19)' 'kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti (gītā 9.21)'
analyzed: nityāni api karmāṇi bandha hetu tva āśaṅakayā jihāsoḥ mumukṣoḥ kutas kāmyeṣu prasaṅagaḥ dūreṇa hi avaram karma gītā iti ca nindita tvāt yajña arthāt karmaṇaḥ anyatra gītā iti ca kāmya karmaṇām bandha hetu tvasya niścita tvāt traiguṇya viṣayāḥ vedāḥ gītā traividyāḥ mām somapāḥ gītā kṣīṇe puṇye martya lokam viśanti gītā

original: iti ca, dūravyavahitatvācca, na kāmyeṣu 'etānyapi' iti vyapadeśaḥ..
analyzed: iti ca dūra vyavahita tvāt ca na kāmyeṣu etāni api iti vyapadeśaḥ

original: tasmāt ajñasya adhikṛtasya mumukṣoḥ
analyzed: tasmāt ajñasya adhikṛtasya mumukṣoḥ

original: niyatasya tu saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate.
analyzed: niyatasya tu saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇaḥ na upapadyate

original: mohāttasya parityāgastāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ..18.7..
analyzed: mohāt tasya parityāgaḥ tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ

original: niyatasya tu nityasya saṃnyāsaḥ parityāgaḥ karmaṇaḥ na upapadyate, ajñasya pāvanatvasya iṣṭatvāt. mohāt ajñānāt tasya niyatasya parityāgaḥ  niyataṃ ca avaśyaṃ kartavyam, tyajyate ca, iti vipratiṣiddham; ataḥ mohanimittaḥ parityāgaḥ tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ mohaśca tamaḥ iti..
analyzed: niyatasya tu nityasya saṃnyāsaḥ parityāgaḥ karmaṇaḥ na upapadyate ajñasya pāvana tvasya iṣṭa tvāt mohāt ajñānāt tasya niyatasya parityāgaḥ niyatam ca avaśyam kartavyam tyajyate ca iti vipratiṣiddham atas moha nimittaḥ parityāgaḥ tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ mohaḥ ca tamaḥ iti

original: duḥkhamityeva yatkarma kāyakleśabhayāttyajet.
analyzed: duḥkham iti eva yat karma kāya kleśa bhayāt tyajet

original: sa kṛtvā rājasaṃ tyāgaṃ naiva tyāgaphalaṃ labhet..18.8..
analyzed: sa kṛtvā rājasam tyāgam na eva tyāga phalam labhet

original: duḥkham iti eva yat karma kāyakleśabhayāt śarīraduḥkhabhayāt tyajet, saḥ kṛtvā rājasaṃ rajonirvartyaṃ tyāgaṃ naiva tyāgaphalaṃ jñānapūrvakasya sarvakarmatyāgasya phalaṃ mokṣākhyaṃ na labhet naiva labheta..
analyzed: duḥkham iti eva yat karma kāya kleśa bhayāt śarīra duḥkha bhayāt tyajet saḥ kṛtvā rājasam rajaḥ nirvartyam tyāgam na eva tyāga phalam jñāna pūrvakasya sarva karma tyāgasya phalam mokṣa ākhyam na labhet na eva labheta

original: kaḥ punaḥ sāttvikaḥ tyāgaḥ iti, āha
analyzed: kaḥ punaḥ sāttvikaḥ tyāgaḥ iti āha

original: kāryamityeva yatkarma niyataṃ kriyate'rjuna.
analyzed: kāryam iti eva yat karma niyatam kriyate ṛjuna

original: saṅagaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ..18.9..
analyzed: saṅagam tyaktvā phalam ca eva sa tyāgaḥ sāttvikaḥ mataḥ

original: kāryaṃ kartavyam ityeva yat karma niyataṃ nityaṃ kriyate nirvartyate he arjuna, saṅagaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ ca eva. etat nityānāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalavattve bhagavadvacanaṃ pramāṇam avocāma. athavā, yadyapi phalaṃ na śrūyate nityasya karmaṇaḥ, tathāpi nityaṃ karma kṛtam ātmasaṃskāraṃ pratyavāyaparihāraṃ vā phalaṃ karoti ātmanaḥ iti kalpayatyeva ajñaḥ.
analyzed: kāryam kartavyam iti eva yat karma niyatam nityam kriyate nirvartyate he arjuna saṅagam tyaktvā phalam ca eva etat nityānām karmaṇām phalavat tve bhagavat vacanam pramāṇam avocāma athavā yadi api phalam na śrūyate nityasya karmaṇaḥ tathā api nityam karma kṛtam ātma saṃskāram pratyavāya parihāram vā phalam karoti ātmanaḥ iti kalpayati eva ajñaḥ

original: tatra tāmapi kalpanāṃ nivārayati 'phalaṃ tyaktvā' ityanena. ataḥ sādhu uktam 'saṅagaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ ca' iti. saḥ tyāgaḥ nityakarmasu saṅagaphalaparityāgaḥ sāttvikaḥ sattvanirvṛttaḥ mataḥ abhipretaḥ..
analyzed: tatra tām api kalpanām nivārayati phalam tyaktvā iti anena atas sādhu uktam saṅagam tyaktvā phalam ca iti saḥ tyāgaḥ nitya karmasu saṅaga phala parityāgaḥ sāttvikaḥ sattva nirvṛttaḥ mataḥ abhipretaḥ

original: nanu karmaparityāgaḥ trividhaḥ saṃnyāsaḥ iti ca prakṛtaḥ. tatra tāmaso rājasaśca uktaḥ tyāgaḥ. katham iha saṅagaphalatyāgaḥ tṛtīyatvena ucyate? yathā trayo brāhmaṇāḥ āgatāḥ, tatra ṣaḍaṅagavidau dvau, kṣatriyaḥ tṛtīyaḥ iti tadvat. naiṣa doṣaḥ tyāgasāmānyena stutyarthatvāt. asti hi karmasaṃnyāsasya phalābhisaṃdhityāgasya ca tyāgatvasāmānyam.
analyzed: nanu karma parityāgaḥ trividhaḥ saṃnyāsaḥ iti ca prakṛtaḥ tatra tāmasaḥ rājasaḥ ca uktaḥ tyāgaḥ katham iha saṅaga phala tyāgaḥ tṛtīya tvena ucyate yathā trayaḥ brāhmaṇāḥ āgatāḥ tatra ṣaḍaṅaga vidau dvau kṣatriyaḥ tṛtīyaḥ iti tadvat na eṣa doṣaḥ tyāga sāmānyena stuti artha tvāt asti hi karma saṃnyāsasya phala abhisaṃdhi tyāgasya ca tyāga tva sāmānyam

original: tatra rājasatāmasatvena karmatyāganindayā karmaphalābhisaṃdhityāgaḥ sāttvikatvena stūyate 'sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ (gītā 18.9)' iti..
analyzed: tatra rājasa tāmasa tvena karma tyāga nindayā karma phala abhisaṃdhi tyāgaḥ sāttvika tvena stūyate sa tyāgaḥ sāttvikaḥ mataḥ gītā iti

original: yastu adhikṛtaḥ saṅagaṃ tyaktvā phalābhisaṃdhiṃ ca nityaṃ karma karoti, tasya phalarāgādinā akaluṣīkriyamāṇam antaḥkaraṇaṃ nityaiśca karmabhiḥ saṃskriyamāṇaṃ viśudhyati. tat viśuddhaṃ prasannam ātmālocanakṣamaṃ bhavati. tasyaiva nityakarmānuṣṭhānena viśuddhāntaḥkaraṇasya ātmajñānābhimukhasya krameṇa yathā tanniṣṭhā syāt, tat vaktavyamiti āha
analyzed: yaḥ tu adhikṛtaḥ saṅagam tyaktvā phala abhisaṃdhim ca nityam karma karoti tasya phala rāga ādinā akaluṣīkriyamāṇam antaḥkaraṇam nityaiḥ ca karmabhiḥ saṃskriyamāṇam viśudhyati tat viśuddham prasannam ātma ālocana kṣamam bhavati tasya eva nitya karma anuṣṭhānena viśuddha antaḥkaraṇasya ātma jñāna abhimukhasya krameṇa yathā tat niṣṭhā syāt tat vaktavyam iti āha

original: na dveṣṭyakuśalaṃ karma kuśale nānuṣajjate.
analyzed: na dveṣṭi akuśalam karma kuśale na anuṣajjate

original: tyāgī sattvasamāviṣṭo medhāvī chinnasaṃśayaḥ..18.10..
analyzed: tyāgī sattva samāviṣṭaḥ medhāvī chinna saṃśayaḥ

original: na dveṣṭi akuśalam aśobhanaṃ kāmyaṃ karma, śarīrārambhadvāreṇa saṃsārakāraṇam, 'kimanena?' ityevam. kuśale śobhane nitye karmaṇi sattvaśuddhijñānotpattitanniṣṭhāhetutvena 'mokṣakāraṇam idam' ityevaṃ na anuṣajjate anuṣaṅagaṃ prītiṃ na karoti ityetat.
analyzed: na dveṣṭi akuśalam aśobhanam kāmyam karma śarīra ārambha dvāreṇa saṃsāra kāraṇam kim anena iti evam kuśale śobhane nitye karmaṇi sattva śuddhi jñāna utpatti tad niṣṭhā hetu tvena mokṣa kāraṇam idam iti evam na anuṣajjate anuṣaṅagam prītim na karoti iti etat

original: kaḥ punaḥ asau? tyāgī pūrvoktena saṅagaphalatyāgena tadvān tyāgī, yaḥ karmaṇi saṅagaṃ tyaktvā tatphalaṃ ca nityakarmānuṣṭhāyī saḥ tyāgī. kadā punaḥ asau akuśalaṃ karma na dveṣṭi, kuśale ca na anuṣajjate iti, ucyate  sattvasamāviṣṭaḥ yadā sattvena ātmānātmavivekavijñānahetunā samāviṣṭaḥ saṃvyāptaḥ, saṃyukta ityetat.

analyzed: upādhi bhūtā na lipyate na anuśayinī bhavati idam aham akārṣam tena aham narakam gamiṣyāmi iti evam yasya buddhiḥ na lipyate saḥ sumatiḥ saḥ paśyati hatvā api saḥ imān lokān sarvān imān prāṇinaḥ iti arthaḥ na hanti hanana kriyām na karoti na nibadhyate na api tad kāryeṇa adharma phalena saṃbadhyate

original: nanu hatvāpi na hanti iti vipratiṣiddham ucyate yadyapi stutiḥ. naiṣa doṣaḥ, laukikapāramārthikadṛṣṭyapekṣayā tadupapatteḥ. dehādyātmabuddhyā 'hantā aham' iti laukikīṃ dṛṣṭim āśritya 'hatvāpi' iti āha. yathādarśitāṃ pāramārthikīṃ dṛṣṭim āśritya 'na hanti na nibadhyate' iti. etat ubhayam upapadyate eva..
analyzed: nanu hatvā api na hanti iti vipratiṣiddham ucyate yadi api stutiḥ na eṣa doṣaḥ laukika pāramārthika dṛṣṭi apekṣayā tad upapatteḥ deha ādi ātma buddhyā hantā aham iti laukikīm dṛṣṭim āśritya hatvā api iti āha yathā darśitām pāramārthikīm dṛṣṭim āśritya na hanti na nibadhyate iti etat ubhayam upapadyate eva

original: nanu adhiṣṭhānādibhiḥ saṃbhūya karotyeva ātmā, 'kartāramātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu (gītā 18.16)' iti kevalaśabdaprayogāt. naiṣa doṣaḥ, ātmanaḥ avikriyasvabhāvatve adhiṣṭhānādibhiḥ saṃhatatvānupapatteḥ. vikriyāvato hi anyaiḥ saṃhananaṃ saṃbhavati, saṃhatya vā kartṛtvaṃ syāt.
analyzed: nanu adhiṣṭhāna ādibhiḥ saṃbhūya karoti eva ātmā kartāram ātmānam kevalam tu gītā iti kevala śabda prayogāt na eṣa doṣaḥ ātmanaḥ avikriya svabhāva tve adhiṣṭhāna ādibhiḥ saṃhata tva anupapatteḥ vikriyāvataḥ hi anyaiḥ saṃhananam saṃbhavati saṃhatya vā kartṛ tvam syāt

original: na tu avikriyasya ātmanaḥ kenacit saṃhananam asti iti na saṃbhūya kartṛtvam upapadyate. ataḥ kevalatvam ātmanaḥ svābhāvikamiti kevalaśabdaḥ anuvādamātram. avikriyatvaṃ ca ātmanaḥ śrutismṛtinyāyaprasiddham. 'avikāryo'yamucyate (gītā 2.25)' 'guṇaireva karmāṇi kriyante' 'śarīrastho'pi na karoti (gītā 13.31)' ityādi asakṛt upapāditaṃ gītāsveva tāvat.
analyzed: na tu avikriyasya ātmanaḥ kenacid saṃhananam asti iti na saṃbhūya kartṛ tvam upapadyate atas kevala tvam ātmanaḥ svābhāvikam iti kevala śabdaḥ anuvāda mātram avikriya tvam ca ātmanaḥ śruti smṛti nyāya prasiddham avikāryā uyam ucyate gītā guṇaiḥ eva karmāṇi kriyante śarīra sthaḥ api na karoti gītā ityādi asakṛt upapāditam gītāsu eva tāvat

original: śrutiṣu ca dhyāyatīva lelāyatīva ityevamādyāsu. nyāyataśca  niravayavam aparatantram avikriyam ātmatattvam iti rājamārgaḥ. vikriyāvattvābhyupagame'pi ātmanaḥ svakīyaiva vikriyā svasya bhavitum arhati, na adhiṣṭhānādīnāṃ karmāṇi ātmakartṛkāṇi syuḥ. na hi parasya karma pareṇa akṛtam āgantum arhati. yattu avidyayā gamitam, na tat tasya.
analyzed: śrutiṣu ca dhyāyati iva lelāyati iva iti evamādyāsu nyāyataḥ ca niravayavam aparatantram avikriyam ātma tattvam iti rājamārgaḥ vikriyāvat tva abhyupagame pi ātmanaḥ svakīyā eva vikriyā svasya bhavitum arhati na adhiṣṭhāna ādīnām karmāṇi ātma kartṛkāṇi syuḥ na hi parasya karma pareṇa akṛtam āgantum arhati yat tu avidyayā gamitam na tat tasya

original: yathā rajatatvaṃ na śuktikāyāḥ; yathā vā talamalinatvaṃ bālaiḥ gamitam avidyayā, na ākāśasya, tathā adhiṣṭhānādivikriyāpi teṣāmeva, na ātmanaḥ. tasmāt yuktam uktam 'ahaṃkṛtatvabuddhilepābhāvāt vidvān na hanti na nibadhyate' iti.
analyzed: yathā rajata tvam na śuktikāyāḥ yathā vā tala malina tvam bālaiḥ gamitam avidyayā na ākāśasya tathā adhiṣṭhāna ādi vikriyā api teṣām eva na ātmanaḥ tasmāt yuktam uktam ahaṃkṛta tva buddhi lepa abhāvāt vidvān na hanti na nibadhyate iti

original: 'nāyaṃ hanti na hanyate (gītā 2.19)' iti pratijñāya 'na jāyate (gītā 2.20)' ityādihetuvacanena avikriyatvam ātmanaḥ uktvā, 'vedāvināśinam (gītā 2.21)' iti viduṣaḥ karmādhikāranivṛttiṃ śāstrādau saṃkṣepataḥ uktvā, madhye prasāritāṃ tatra tatra prasaṅagaṃ kṛtvā iha upasaṃharati śāstrārthapiṇḍīkaraṇāya vidvān na hanti na nibadhyate iti.
analyzed: na ayam hanti na hanyate gītā iti pratijñāya na jāyate gītā iti ādi hetu vacanena avikriya tvam ātmanaḥ uktvā veda avināśinam gītā iti viduṣaḥ karma adhikāra nivṛttim śāstra ādau saṃkṣepataḥ uktvā madhye prasāritām tatra tatra prasaṅagam kṛtvā iha upasaṃharati śāstra artha piṇḍīkaraṇāya vidvān na hanti na nibadhyate iti

original: evaṃ ca sati dehabhṛttvābhimānānupapattau avidyākṛtāśeṣakarmasaṃnyāsopapatteḥ saṃnyāsinām aniṣṭādi trividhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalaṃ na bhavati iti upapannam; tadviparyayācca itareṣāṃ bhavati ityetacca aparihāryam iti eṣaḥ gītāśāstrārthaḥ upasaṃhṛtaḥ.
analyzed: evam ca sati dehabhṛt tva abhimāna anupapattau avidyā kṛta aśeṣa karma saṃnyāsa upapatteḥ saṃnyāsinām aniṣṭa ādi trividham karmaṇaḥ phalam na bhavati iti upapannam tad viparyayāt ca itareṣām bhavati iti etat ca aparihāryam iti eṣaḥ gītā śāstra arthaḥ upasaṃhṛtaḥ

original: sa eṣaḥ sarvavedārthasāraḥ nipuṇamatibhiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ vicārya pratipattavyaḥ iti tatra tatra prakaraṇavibhāgena darśitaḥ asmābhiḥ śāstranyāyānusāreṇa..
analyzed: saḥ eṣaḥ sarva veda artha sāraḥ nipuṇa matibhiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ vicārya pratipattavyaḥ iti tatra tatra prakaraṇa vibhāgena darśitaḥ asmābhiḥ śāstra nyāya anusāreṇa

original: atha idānīṃ karmaṇāṃ pravartakam ucyate
analyzed: atha idānīm karmaṇām pravartakam ucyate

original: jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ parijñātā trividhā karmacodanā.
analyzed: jñānam jñeyam parijñātā trividhā karma codanā

original: jñānaṃ jñāyate anena iti sarvaviṣayam aviśeṣeṇa ucyate. tathā jñeyaṃ jñātavyam, tadapi sāmānyenaiva sarvam ucyate. tathā parijñātā upādhilakṣaṇaḥ avidyākalpitaḥ bhoktā. iti etat trayam aviśeṣeṇa sarvakarmaṇāṃ pravartikā trividhā triprakārā karmacodanā. jñānādīnāṃ hi trayāṇāṃ saṃnipāte hānopādānādiprayojanaḥ sarvakarmārambhaḥ syāt.
analyzed: jñānam jñāyate anena iti sarva viṣayam aviśeṣeṇa ucyate tathā jñeyam jñātavyam tat api sāmānyena eva sarvam ucyate tathā parijñātā upādhi lakṣaṇaḥ avidyā kalpitaḥ bhoktā iti etat trayam aviśeṣeṇa sarva karmaṇām pravartikā trividhā tri prakārā karma codanā jñāna ādīnām hi trayāṇām saṃnipāte hāna upādāna ādi prayojanaḥ sarva karma ārambhaḥ syāt

original: tataḥ pañcabhiḥ adhiṣṭhānādibhiḥ ārabdhaṃ vāṅamanaḥkāyāśrayabhedena tridhā rāśībhūtaṃ triṣu karaṇādiṣu saṃgṛhyate ityetat ucyate  karaṇaṃ kriyate anena iti bāhyaṃ śrotrādi, antaḥsthaṃ buddhyādi, karma īpsitatamaṃ kartuḥ kriyayā vyāpyamānam, kartā karaṇānāṃ vyāpārayitā upādhilakṣaṇaḥ, iti trividhaḥ triprakāraḥ karmasaṃgrahaḥ, saṃgṛhyate asminniti
analyzed: tatas pañcabhiḥ adhiṣṭhāna ādibhiḥ ārabdham vāṅa manaḥ kāya āśraya bhedena tridhā rāśībhūtam triṣu karaṇa ādiṣu saṃgṛhyate iti etat ucyate karaṇam kriyate anena iti bāhyam śrotra ādi antaḥstham buddhi ādi karma īpsitatamam kartuḥ kriyayā vyāpyamānam kartā karaṇānām vyāpārayitā upādhi lakṣaṇaḥ iti trividhaḥ tri prakāraḥ karma saṃgrahaḥ saṃgṛhyate asmin iti

original: saṃgrahaḥ, karmaṇaḥ saṃgrahaḥ karmasaṃgrahaḥ, karma eṣu hi triṣu samavaiti, tena ayaṃ trividhaḥ karmasaṃgrahaḥ..
analyzed: saṃgrahaḥ karmaṇaḥ saṃgrahaḥ karma saṃgrahaḥ karma eṣu hi triṣu samavaiti tena ayam trividhaḥ karma saṃgrahaḥ

original: atha idānīṃ kriyākārakaphalānāṃ sarveṣāṃ guṇātmakatvāt sattvarajastamoguṇabhedataḥ trividhaḥ bhedaḥ vaktavya iti ārabhyate
analyzed: atha idānīm kriyā kāraka phalānām sarveṣām guṇa ātmaka tvāt sattva rajaḥ tamaḥ guṇa bhedataḥ trividhaḥ bhedaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti ārabhyate

analyzed: jñānam karma ca karma kriyā na kārakam pāribhāṣikam īpsitatamam karma kartā ca nirvartakaḥ kriyāṇām tridhā eva avadhāraṇam guṇa vyatirikta jāti antara abhāva pradarśana artham guṇa bhedataḥ sattva ādi bhedena iti arthaḥ procyate kathyate guṇa saṃkhyāne kāpile śāstre tat api guṇa saṃkhyāna śāstram guṇa bhoktṛ viṣaye pramāṇam eva

original: paramārthabrahmaikatvaviṣaye yadyapi virudhyate, tathāpi te hi kāpilāḥ guṇagauṇavyāpāranirūpaṇe abhiyuktāḥ iti tacchāstramapi vakṣyamāṇārthastutyarthatvena upādīyate iti na virodhaḥ. yathāvat yathānyāyaṃ yathāśāstraṃ śrṛṇu tānyapi jñānādīni tadbhedajātāni guṇabhedakṛtāni śrṛṇu, vakṣyamāṇe arthe manaḥsamādhiṃ kuru ityarthaḥ..
analyzed: paramārtha brahma ekatva viṣaye yadi api virudhyate tathā api te hi kāpilāḥ guṇa gauṇa vyāpāra nirūpaṇe abhiyuktāḥ iti tat śāstram api vakṣyamāṇa artha stuti artha tvena upādīyate iti na virodhaḥ yathāvat yathānyāyam yathāśāstram śrṛṇu tāni api jñāna ādīni tad bheda jātāni guṇa bheda kṛtāni śrṛṇu vakṣyamāṇe arthe manaḥ samādhim kuru iti arthaḥ

analyzed: jñānasya tu tāvat trividha tvam ucyate

analyzed: vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tat jñānam viddhi rājasam

analyzed: pṛthaktvena tu bhedena pratiśarīram anya tvena yat jñānam nānā bhāvān bhinnān ātmanaḥ pṛthagvidhān pṛthak prakārān bhinna lakṣaṇān iti arthaḥ vetti vijānāti yat jñānam sarveṣu bhūteṣu jñānasya kartṛ tva asaṃbhavāt yena jñānena vetti iti arthaḥ tat jñānam viddhi rājasam rajaḥ guṇa nirvṛttam

original: ayathābhūtārthavat, yathābhūtaḥ arthaḥ tattvārthaḥ, saḥ asya jñeyabhūtaḥ astīti tattvārthavat, na tattvārthavat atattvārthavat; ahaitukatvādeva alpaṃ ca, alpaviṣayatvāt alpaphalatvādvā. tat tāmasam udāhṛtam. tāmasānāṃ hi prāṇinām avivekinām īdṛśaṃ jñānaṃ dṛśyate..

original: yat tat sukham agre pūrvaṃ prathamasaṃnipāte jñānavairāgyadhyānasamādhyārambhe atyantāyāsapūrvakatvāt viṣamiva duḥkhātmakaṃ bhavati, pariṇāme jñānavairāgyādiparipākajaṃ sukham amṛtopamam, tat sukhaṃ sāttvikaṃ proktaṃ vidvadbhiḥ, ātmanaḥ buddhiḥ ātmabuddhiḥ, ātmabuddheḥ prasādaḥ nairmalyaṃ salilasya iva svacchatā, tataḥ jātaṃ ātmabuddhiprasādajam.
analyzed: yat tat sukham agre pūrvam prathama saṃnipāte jñāna vairāgya dhyāna samādhi ārambhe atyanta āyāsa pūrvaka tvāt viṣam iva duḥkha ātmakam bhavati pariṇāme jñāna vairāgya ādi paripāka jam sukham amṛta upamam tat sukham sāttvikam proktam vidvadbhiḥ ātmanaḥ buddhiḥ ātma buddhiḥ ātma buddheḥ prasādaḥ nairmalyam salilasya iva svaccha tā tatas jātam ātma buddhi prasāda jam

original: ātmaviṣayā vā ātmāvalambanā vā buddhiḥ ātmabuddhiḥ, tatprasādaprakarṣādvā jātamityetat. tasmāt sāttvikaṃ tat..
analyzed: ātma viṣayā vā ātma avalambanā vā buddhiḥ ātma buddhiḥ tad prasāda prakarṣāt vā jātam iti etat tasmāt sāttvikam tat

original: viṣayendriyasaṃyogādyattadagre'mṛtopamam.
analyzed: viṣaya indriya saṃyogāt yat tat agre mṛta upamam

original: pariṇāme viṣamiva tatsukhaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam..18.38..
analyzed: pariṇāme viṣam iva tat sukham rājasam smṛtam

original: viṣayendriyasaṃyogāt jāyate yat sukham tat sukham agre prathamakṣaṇe amṛtopamam amṛtasamam, pariṇāme viṣamiva, balavīryarūpaprajñāmedhādhanotsāhahānihetutvāt adharmatajjanitanarakādihetutvācca pariṇāme tadupabhogapariṇāmānte viṣamiva, tat sukhaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam..
analyzed: viṣaya indriya saṃyogāt jāyate yat sukham tat sukham agre prathama kṣaṇe amṛta upamam amṛta samam pariṇāme viṣam iva bala vīrya rūpa prajñā medhā dhana utsāha hāni hetu tvāt adharma tad janita naraka ādi hetu tvāt ca pariṇāme tad upabhoga pariṇāma ante viṣam iva tat sukham rājasam smṛtam

original: yadagre cānubandhe ca sukhaṃ mohanamātmanaḥ.
analyzed: yat agre ca anubandhe ca sukham mohanam ātmanaḥ

original: nidrālasyapramādotthaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛtam..18.39..
analyzed: nidrā ālasya pramāda uttham tat tāmasam udāhṛtam

original: yat agre ca anubandhe ca avasānottarakāle ca sukhaṃ mohanaṃ mohakaram ātmanaḥ nidrālasyapramādotthaṃ nidrā ca ālasyaṃ ca pramādaśca tebhyaḥ samuttiṣṭhatīti nidrālasyapramādottham, tat tāmasam udāhṛtam..
analyzed: yat agre ca anubandhe ca avasāna uttara kāle ca sukham mohanam moha karam ātmanaḥ nidrā ālasya pramāda uttham nidrā ca ālasyam ca pramādaḥ ca tebhyaḥ samuttiṣṭhati iti nidrā ālasya pramāda uttham tat tāmasam udāhṛtam

original: atha idānīṃ prakaraṇopasaṃhārārthaḥ ślokaḥ ārabhyate
analyzed: atha idānīm prakaraṇa upasaṃhāra arthaḥ ślokaḥ ārabhyate

original: na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ.
analyzed: na tat asti pṛthivyām vā divi deveṣu vā punar

original: sattvaṃ prakṛtijairmuktaṃ yadebhiḥ syātitrabhirguṇaiḥ..18.40..
analyzed: sattvam prakṛti jaiḥ muktam yat ebhiḥ syāt trabhiḥ guṇaiḥ

original: na tat asti tat nāsti pṛthivyāṃ vā manuṣyādiṣu sattvaṃ prāṇijātam anyadvā aprāṇi, divi deveṣu vā punaḥ sattvam, prakṛtijaiḥ prakṛtitaḥ jātaiḥ ebhiḥ tribhiḥ guṇaiḥ sattvādibhiḥ muktaṃ parityaktaṃ yat syāt, na tat asti iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ..
analyzed: na tat asti tat na asti pṛthivyām vā manuṣya ādiṣu sattvam prāṇi jātam anyat vā aprāṇi divi deveṣu vā punar sattvam prakṛti jaiḥ prakṛtitaḥ jātaiḥ ebhiḥ tribhiḥ guṇaiḥ sattva ādibhiḥ muktam parityaktam yat syāt na tat asti iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ

original: sarvaḥ saṃsāraḥ kriyākārakaphalalakṣaṇaḥ sattvarajastamoguṇātmakaḥ avidyāparikalpitaḥ samūlaḥ anarthaḥ uktaḥ, vṛkṣarūpakalpanayā ca 'ūrdhvamūlam (gītā 15.1)' ityādinā, 'taṃ ca asaṅagaśastreṇa dṛḍhena cchittvā (gītā 15.3) tataḥ padaṃ tatparimārgitavyam (gītā 15.4)' iti ca uktam.
analyzed: sarvaḥ saṃsāraḥ kriyā kāraka phala lakṣaṇaḥ sattva rajaḥ tamaḥ guṇa ātmakaḥ avidyā parikalpitaḥ samūlaḥ anarthaḥ uktaḥ vṛkṣa rūpa kalpanayā ca ūrdhva mūlam gītā ityādinā tam ca asaṅaga śastreṇa dṛḍhena chittvā gītā tatas padam tat parimārgitavyam gītā iti ca uktam

original: tatra ca sarvasya triguṇātmakatvāt saṃsārakāraṇanivṛttyanupapattau prāptāyām, yathā tannivṛttiḥ syāt tathā vaktavyam, sarvaśca gītāśāstrārthaḥ upasaṃhartavyaḥ, etāvāneva ca sarvavedasmṛtyarthaḥ puruṣārtham icchadbhiḥ anuṣṭheyaḥ ityevamartham 'brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśām' ityādiḥ ārabhyate
analyzed: tatra ca sarvasya triguṇa ātmaka tvāt saṃsāra kāraṇa nivṛtti anupapattau prāptāyām yathā tad nivṛttiḥ syāt tathā vaktavyam sarvaḥ ca gītā śāstra arthaḥ upasaṃhartavyaḥ etāvān eva ca sarva veda smṛti arthaḥ puruṣa artham icchadbhiḥ anuṣṭheyaḥ iti evam artham brāhmaṇa kṣatriya viśām ityādiḥ ārabhyate

original: brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca paraṃtapa.
analyzed: brāhmaṇa kṣatriya viśām śūdrāṇām ca paraṃtapa

original: karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāvaprabhavairguṇaiḥ..18.41..
analyzed: karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāva prabhavaiḥ guṇaiḥ

original: brāhmaṇāśca kṣatriyāśca viśaśca brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśaḥ, teṣāṃ brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca  śūdrāṇām asamāsakaraṇam ekajātitve sati vedānadhikārāt  he paraṃtapa, karmāṇi pravibhaktāni itaretaravibhāgena vyavasthāpitāni.
analyzed: brāhmaṇāḥ ca kṣatriyāḥ ca viśaḥ ca brāhmaṇa kṣatriya viśaḥ teṣām brāhmaṇa kṣatriya viśām śūdrāṇām ca śūdrāṇām a samāsa karaṇam eka jāti tve sati veda anadhikārāt he paraṃtapa karmāṇi pravibhaktāni itaretara vibhāgena vyavasthāpitāni

original: kena? svabhāvaprabhavaiḥ guṇaiḥ, svabhāvaḥ īśvarasya prakṛtiḥ triguṇātmikā māyā sā prabhavaḥ yeṣāṃ guṇānāṃ te svabhāvaprabhavāḥ, taiḥ, śamādīni karmāṇi pravibhaktāni brāhmaṇādīnām.
analyzed: kena svabhāva prabhavaiḥ guṇaiḥ svabhāvaḥ īśvarasya prakṛtiḥ triguṇa ātmikā māyā sā prabhavaḥ yeṣām guṇānām te svabhāva prabhavāḥ taiḥ śama ādīni karmāṇi pravibhaktāni brāhmaṇa ādīnām

original: athavā brāhmaṇasvabhāvasya sattvaguṇaḥ prabhavaḥ kāraṇam, tathā kṣatriyasvabhāvasya sattvopasarjanaṃ rajaḥ prabhavaḥ, vaiśyasvabhāvasya tamaupasarjanaṃ rajaḥ prabhavaḥ, śūdrasvabhāvasya rajaupasarjanaṃ tamaḥ prabhavaḥ, praśāntyaiśvaryehāmūḍhatāsvabhāvadarśanāt caturṇām.
analyzed: athavā brāhmaṇa svabhāvasya sattva guṇaḥ prabhavaḥ kāraṇam tathā kṣatriya svabhāvasya sattva upasarjanam rajaḥ prabhavaḥ vaiśya svabhāvasya tamaḥ upasarjanam rajaḥ prabhavaḥ śūdra svabhāvasya rajaḥ upasarjanam tamaḥ prabhavaḥ praśānti aiśvarya iha amūḍhatā svabhāva darśanāt caturṇām

original: athavā, janmāntarakṛtasaṃskāraḥ prāṇināṃ vartamānajanmani svakāryābhimukhatvena abhivyaktaḥ svabhāvaḥ, saḥ prabhavo yeṣāṃ guṇānāṃ te svabhāvaprabhavāḥ guṇāḥ; guṇaprādurbhāvasya niṣkāraṇatvānupapatteḥ. 'svabhāvaḥ kāraṇam' iti ca kāraṇaviśeṣopādānam.
analyzed: athavā janma antara kṛta saṃskāraḥ prāṇinām vartamāna janmani sva kārya abhimukha tvena abhivyaktaḥ svabhāvaḥ saḥ prabhavaḥ yeṣām guṇānām te svabhāva prabhavāḥ guṇāḥ guṇa prādurbhāvasya niṣkāraṇa tva anupapatteḥ svabhāvaḥ kāraṇam iti ca kāraṇa viśeṣa upādānam

original: evaṃ svabhāvaprabhavaiḥ prakṛtibhavaiḥ sattvarajastamobhiḥ guṇaiḥ svakāryānurūpeṇa śamādīni karmāṇi pravibhaktāni..
analyzed: evam svabhāva prabhavaiḥ prakṛti bhavaiḥ sattva rajaḥ tamobhiḥ guṇaiḥ sva kārya anurūpeṇa śama ādīni karmāṇi pravibhaktāni

original: nanu śāstrapravibhaktāni śāstreṇa vihitāni brāhmaṇādīnāṃ śamādīni karmāṇi; katham ucyate sattvādiguṇapravibhaktāni iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; śāstreṇāpi brāhmaṇādīnāṃ sattvādiguṇaviśeṣāpekṣayaiva śamādīni karmāṇi pravibhaktāni, na guṇānapekṣayā, iti śāstrapravibhaktānyapi karmāṇi guṇapravibhaktāni iti ucyate..
analyzed: nanu śāstra pravibhaktāni śāstreṇa vihitāni brāhmaṇa ādīnām śama ādīni karmāṇi katham ucyate sattva ādi guṇa pravibhaktāni iti na eṣa doṣaḥ śāstreṇa api brāhmaṇa ādīnām sattva ādi guṇa viśeṣa apekṣayā eva śama ādīni karmāṇi pravibhaktāni na guṇa anapekṣayā iti śāstra pravibhaktāni api karmāṇi guṇa pravibhaktāni iti ucyate

original: kāni punaḥ tāni karmāṇi iti, ucyate
analyzed: kāni punar tāni karmāṇi iti ucyate

original: śamo damastapaḥ śaucaṃ kṣāntirārjavameva ca.
analyzed: śamaḥ damaḥ tapaḥ śaucam kṣāntiḥ ārjavam eva ca

original: jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ brahmakarma svabhāvajam..18.42..
analyzed: jñānam vijñānam āstikyam brahma karma svabhāva jam

original: śamaḥ damaśca yathāvyākhyātārthau, tapaḥ yathoktaṃ śārīrādi, śaucaṃ vyākhyātam, kṣāntiḥ kṣamā, ārjavam ṛjutā eva ca jñānaṃ vijñānam, āstikyam āstikabhāvaḥ śraddadhānatā āgamārtheṣu, brahmakarma brāhmaṇajāteḥ karma svabhāvajam  yat uktaṃ svabhāvaprabhavairguṇaiḥ pravibhaktāni iti tadevoktaṃ svabhāvajam iti..
analyzed: śamaḥ damaḥ ca yathā vyākhyāta arthau tapaḥ yathā uktam śārīra ādi śaucam vyākhyātam kṣāntiḥ kṣamā ārjavam ṛju tā eva ca jñānam vijñānam āstikyam āstika bhāvaḥ śraddadhāna tā āgama artheṣu brahma karma brāhmaṇa jāteḥ karma svabhāva jam yat uktam svabhāva prabhavaiḥ guṇaiḥ pravibhaktāni iti tat eva uktam svabhāva jam iti

original: śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ yuddhe cāpyapalāyanam.
analyzed: śauryam tejaḥ dhṛtiḥ dākṣyam yuddhe ca api apalāyanam

original: dānamīśvarabhāvaśca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam..18.43..
analyzed: dānam īśvara bhāvaḥ ca kṣātram karma svabhāva jam

original: śauryaṃ śūrasya bhāvaḥ, tejaḥ prāgalbhyam, dhṛtiḥ dhāraṇam, sarvāvasthāsu anavasādaḥ bhavati yayā dhṛtyā uttambhitasya, dākṣyaṃ dakṣasya bhāvaḥ, sahasā pratyutpanneṣu kāryeṣu avyāmohena pravṛttiḥ, yuddhe cāpi apalāyanam aparāṅamukhībhāvaḥ śatrubhyaḥ, dānaṃ deyadravyeṣu muktahastatā, īśvarabhāvaśca īśvarasya bhāvaḥ, prabhuśaktiprakaṭīkaraṇam
analyzed: śauryam śūrasya bhāvaḥ tejaḥ prāgalbhyam dhṛtiḥ dhāraṇam sarva avasthāsu anavasādaḥ bhavati yayā dhṛtyā uttambhitasya dākṣyam dakṣasya bhāvaḥ sahasā pratyutpanneṣu kāryeṣu avyāmohena pravṛttiḥ yuddhe ca api apalāyanam aparāṅamukhībhāvaḥ śatrubhyaḥ dānam deya dravyeṣu muktahasta tā īśvara bhāvaḥ ca īśvarasya bhāvaḥ prabhu śakti prakaṭīkaraṇam

original: īśitavyān prati, kṣātraṃ karma kṣatriyajāteḥ vihitaṃ karma kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam..
analyzed: īśitavyān prati kṣātram karma kṣatriya jāteḥ vihitam karma kṣātram karma svabhāva jam

original: kṛṣigaurakṣyavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyakarma svabhāvajam.
analyzed: kṛṣi gaurakṣya vāṇijyam vaiśya karma svabhāva jam

original: paricaryātmakaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāvajam..18.44..
analyzed: paricaryā ātmakam karma śūdrasya api svabhāva jam

original: kṛṣigaurakṣyavāṇijyaṃ kṛṣiśca gaurakṣyaṃ ca vāṇijyaṃ ca kṛṣigaurakṣyavāṇijyam, kṛṣiḥ bhūmeḥ vilekhanam, gaurakṣyaṃ gāḥ rakṣatīti gorakṣaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ gaurakṣyam, pāśupālyam ityarthaḥ, vāṇijyaṃ vaṇikkarma krayavikrayādilakṣaṇaṃ vaiśyakarma vaiśyajāteḥ karma vaiśyakarma svabhāvajam. paricaryātmakaṃ śuśrūṣāsvabhāvaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāvajam..
analyzed: kṛṣi gaurakṣya vāṇijyam kṛṣiḥ ca gaurakṣyam ca vāṇijyam ca kṛṣi gaurakṣya vāṇijyam kṛṣiḥ bhūmeḥ vilekhanam gaurakṣyam gāḥ rakṣati iti gorakṣaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ gaurakṣyam pāśupālyam iti arthaḥ vāṇijyam vaṇij karma kraya vikraya ādi lakṣaṇam vaiśya karma vaiśya jāteḥ karma vaiśya karma svabhāva jam paricaryā ātmakam śuśrūṣā svabhāvam karma śūdrasya api svabhāva jam

original: eteṣāṃ jātivihitānāṃ karmaṇāṃ samyaganuṣṭhitānāṃ svargaprāptiḥ phalaṃ svabhāvataḥ, 'varṇā āśramāśca svakarmaniṣṭhāḥ pretya karmaphalamanubhūya tataḥ śeṣeṇa viśiṣṭadeśajātikuladharmāyuḥśrutavṛttavittasukhamedhaso janma pratipadyante' ityādismṛtibhyaḥ (ā. smṛ. 2.2.2.3); purāṇe ca varṇinām āśramiṇāṃ ca lokaphalabhedaviśeṣasmaraṇāt.
analyzed: eteṣām jāti vihitānām karmaṇām samyak anuṣṭhitānām svarga prāptiḥ phalam svabhāvataḥ varṇāḥ āśramāḥ ca sva karma niṣṭhāḥ pretya karma phalam anubhūya tatas śeṣeṇa viśiṣṭa deśa jāti kula dharma āyuḥ śruta vṛtta vitta sukha medhasaḥ janma pratipadyante ityādi smṛtibhyaḥ smṛ purāṇe ca varṇinām āśramiṇām ca loka phala bheda viśeṣa smaraṇāt

original: kāraṇāntarāttu idaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ phalam
analyzed: kāraṇa antarāt tu idam vakṣyamāṇam phalam

original: sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ.
analyzed: sve sve karmaṇi abhirataḥ saṃsiddhim labhate naraḥ

original: svakarmanirataḥ siddhiṃ yathā vindati tacchṛṇu..18.45..
analyzed: sva karma nirataḥ siddhim yathā vindati tat śṛṇu

original: sve sve yathoktalakṣaṇabhede karmaṇi abhirataḥ tatparaḥ saṃsiddhiṃ svakarmānuṣṭhānāt aśuddhikṣaye sati kāyendriyāṇāṃ jñānaniṣṭhāyogyatālakṣaṇāṃ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate prāpnoti naraḥ adhikṛtaḥ puruṣaḥ; kiṃ svakarmānuṣṭhānata eva sākṣāt saṃsiddhiḥ? na; kathaṃ tarhi? svakarmanirataḥ siddhiṃ yathā yena prakāreṇa vindati, tat śṛṇu..
analyzed: sve sve yathā ukta lakṣaṇa bhede karmaṇi abhirataḥ tatparaḥ saṃsiddhim sva karma anuṣṭhānāt aśuddhi kṣaye sati kāya indriyāṇām jñāna niṣṭhā yogya tā lakṣaṇām saṃsiddhim labhate prāpnoti naraḥ adhikṛtaḥ puruṣaḥ kim sva karma anuṣṭhānataḥ eva sākṣāt saṃsiddhiḥ na katham tarhi sva karma nirataḥ siddhim yathā yena prakāreṇa vindati tat śṛṇu

original: yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yena sarvamidaṃ tatam.
analyzed: yatas pravṛttiḥ bhūtānām yena sarvam idam tatam

original: svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ..18.46..
analyzed: sva karmaṇā tam abhyarcya siddhim vindati mānavaḥ

original: yataḥ yasmāt pravṛttiḥ utpattiḥ ceṣṭā vā yasmāt antaryāmiṇaḥ īśvarāt bhūtānāṃ prāṇināṃ syāt, yena īśvareṇa sarvam idaṃ tataṃ jagat vyāptam svakarmaṇā pūrvoktena prativarṇaṃ tam īśvaram abhyarcya pūjayitvā ārādhya kevalaṃ jñānaniṣṭhāyogyatālakṣaṇāṃ siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ manuṣyaḥ..
analyzed: yatas yasmāt pravṛttiḥ utpattiḥ ceṣṭā vā yasmāt antaryāmiṇaḥ īśvarāt bhūtānām prāṇinām syāt yena īśvareṇa sarvam idam tatam jagat vyāptam sva karmaṇā pūrva uktena prativarṇam tam īśvaram abhyarcya pūjayitvā ārādhya kevalam jñāna niṣṭhā yogya tā lakṣaṇām siddhim vindati mānavaḥ manuṣyaḥ

original: yataḥ evam, ataḥ
analyzed: yatas evam atas

original: śreyānsvadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmātsvanuṣṭhitāt.
analyzed: śreyān svadharmaḥ viguṇaḥ para dharmāt su anuṣṭhitāt

original: svabhāvaniyataṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam..18.47..
analyzed: svabhāva niyatam karma kurvan āpnoti kilbiṣam

original: śreyān praśasyataraḥ svo dharmaḥ svadharmaḥ, viguṇo'pi iti apiśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ, paradharmāt. svabhāvaniyataṃ svabhāvena niyatam, yaduktaṃ svabhāvajamiti, tadevoktaṃ svabhāvaniyatam iti; yathā viṣajātasya kṛmeḥ viṣaṃ na doṣakaram, tathā svabhāvaniyataṃ karma kurvan na āpnoti kilbiṣaṃ pāpam..
analyzed: śreyān praśasyataraḥ svaḥ dharmaḥ svadharmaḥ viguṇaḥ api iti api śabdaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ para dharmāt svabhāva niyatam svabhāvena niyatam yat uktam svabhāva jam iti tat eva uktam svabhāva niyatam iti yathā viṣa jātasya kṛmeḥ viṣam na doṣa karam tathā svabhāva niyatam karma kurvan na āpnoti kilbiṣam pāpam

original: svabhāvaniyataṃ karma kurvāṇo viṣajaḥ iva kṛmiḥ kilbiṣaṃ na āpnotīti uktam; paradharmaśca bhayāvahaḥ iti, anātmajñaśca 'na hi kaścitkṣaṇamapi akarmakṛttiṣṭhati (gītā 3.5)' iti. ataḥ
analyzed: svabhāva niyatam karma kurvāṇaḥ viṣa jaḥ iva kṛmiḥ kilbiṣam na āpnoti iti uktam para dharmaḥ ca bhaya āvahaḥ iti anātma jñaḥ ca na hi kaścid kṣaṇam api akarma kṛt tiṣṭhati gītā iti atas

original: sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi na tyajet.
analyzed: sahajam karma kaunteya sa doṣam api na tyajet

original: sarvārambhā hi doṣeṇa dhūmenāgnirivāvṛtāḥ..18.48..
analyzed: sarva ārambhāḥ hi doṣeṇa dhūmena agniḥ iva āvṛtāḥ

original: sahajaṃ saha janmanaiva utpannam. kiṃ tat? karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi triguṇātmakatvāt na tyajet. sarvārambhāḥ ārabhyanta iti ārambhāḥ, sarvakarmāṇi ityetat; prakaraṇāt ye kecit ārambhāḥ svadharmāḥ paradharmāśca, te sarve hi yasmāt  triguṇātmakatvam atra hetuḥ  triguṇātmakatvāt doṣeṇa dhūmena sahajena agniriva, āvṛtāḥ.
analyzed: sahajam saha janmanā eva utpannam kim tat karma kaunteya sa doṣam api triguṇa ātmaka tvāt na tyajet sarva ārambhāḥ ārabhyante iti ārambhāḥ sarva karmāṇi iti etat prakaraṇāt ye kecid ārambhāḥ sva dharmāḥ para dharmāḥ ca te sarve hi yasmāt triguṇa ātmaka tvam atra hetuḥ triguṇa ātmaka tvāt doṣeṇa dhūmena sahajena agniḥ iva āvṛtāḥ

original: sahajasya karmaṇaḥ svadharmākhyasya parityāgena paradharmānuṣṭhāne'pi doṣāt naiva mucyate; bhayāvahaśca paradharmaḥ. na ca śakyate aśeṣataḥ tyaktum ajñena karma yataḥ, tasmāt na tyajet ityarthaḥ..
analyzed: sahajasya karmaṇaḥ svadharma ākhyasya parityāgena para dharma anuṣṭhāne api doṣāt na eva mucyate bhaya āvahaḥ ca para dharmaḥ na ca śakyate aśeṣatas tyaktum ajñena karma yatas tasmāt na tyajet iti arthaḥ

original: kim aśeṣataḥ tyaktum aśakyaṃ karma iti na tyajet? kiṃ vā sahajasya karmaṇaḥ tyāge doṣo bhavatīti? kiṃ ca ataḥ? yadi
analyzed: kim aśeṣatas tyaktum aśakyam karma iti na tyajet kim vā sahajasya karmaṇaḥ tyāge doṣaḥ bhavati iti kim ca atas yadi

original: tāvat aśeṣataḥ tyaktum aśakyam iti na tyājyaṃ sahajaṃ karma, evaṃ tarhi aśeṣataḥ tyāge guṇa eva syāditi siddhaṃ bhavati. satyam evam;
analyzed: tāvat aśeṣatas tyaktum aśakyam iti na tyājyam sahajam karma evam tarhi aśeṣatas tyāge guṇaḥ eva syāt iti siddham bhavati satyam evam

original: aśeṣataḥ tyāga eva na upapadyate iti cet, kiṃ nityapracalitātmakaḥ puruṣaḥ, yathā sāṃkhyānāṃ guṇāḥ? kiṃ vā kriyaiva kārakam, yathā bauddhānāṃ skandhāḥ kṣaṇapradhvaṃsinaḥ? ubhayathāpi karmaṇaḥ aśeṣataḥ tyāgaḥ na saṃbhavati. atha tṛtīyo'pi pakṣaḥ  yadā karoti tadā sakriyaṃ vastu. yadā na karoti, tadā niṣkriyaṃ tadeva.
analyzed: aśeṣatas tyāgaḥ eva na upapadyate iti ced kim nitya pracalita ātmakaḥ puruṣaḥ yathā sāṃkhyānām guṇāḥ kim vā kriyā eva kārakam yathā bauddhānām skandhāḥ kṣaṇa pradhvaṃsinaḥ ubhayathā api karmaṇaḥ aśeṣatas tyāgaḥ na saṃbhavati atha tṛtīyaḥ api pakṣaḥ yadā karoti tadā sa kriyam vastu yadā na karoti tadā niṣkriyam tat eva

original: tatra evaṃ sati śakyaṃ karma aśeṣataḥ tyaktum. ayaṃ tu asmin tṛtīye pakṣe viśeṣaḥ  na nityapracalitaṃ vastu, nāpi kriyaiva kārakam. kiṃ tarhi? vyavasthite dravye avidyamānā kriyā utpadyate, vidyamānā ca vinaśyati. śuddhaṃ tat dravyaṃ śaktimat avatiṣṭhate. iti evam āhuḥ kāṇādāḥ. tadeva ca kārakam iti. asmin pakṣe ko doṣaḥ iti.
analyzed: tatra evam sati śakyam karma aśeṣatas tyaktum ayam tu asmin tṛtīye pakṣe viśeṣaḥ na nitya pracalitam vastu na api kriyā eva kārakam kim tarhi vyavasthite dravye avidyamānā kriyā utpadyate vidyamānā ca vinaśyati śuddham tat dravyam śaktimat avatiṣṭhate iti evam āhuḥ kāṇādāḥ tat eva ca kārakam iti asmin pakṣe kaḥ doṣaḥ iti

original: ayameva tu doṣaḥ  yatastu abhāgavataṃ matam idam. kathaṃ jñāyate? yataḥ āha bhagavān 'nāsato vidyate bhāvaḥ (gītā 2.16)' ityādi. kāṇādānāṃ hi asataḥ bhāvaḥ, sataśca abhāvaḥ, iti idaṃ matam abhāgavatam. abhāgavatamapi nyāyavaccet ko doṣaḥ iti cet, ucyate  doṣavattu idam, sarvapramāṇavirodhāt.
analyzed: ayam eva tu doṣaḥ yatas tu abhāgavatam matam idam katham jñāyate yatas āha bhagavān na asataḥ vidyate bhāvaḥ gītā ityādi kāṇādānām hi asataḥ bhāvaḥ sataḥ ca abhāvaḥ iti idam matam abhāgavatam abhāgavatam api nyāyavat ced kaḥ doṣaḥ iti ced ucyate doṣavat tu idam sarva pramāṇa virodhāt

original: katham? yadi tāvat dvyaṇukādi dravyaṃ prāk utpatteḥ atyantameva asat, utpannaṃ ca sthitaṃ kañcit kālaṃ punaḥ atyantameva asattvam āpadyate, tathā ca sati asadeva sat jāyate, sadeva asattvam, āpadyate, abhāvaḥ bhāvo bhavati, bhāvaśca abhāvo bhavati;
analyzed: katham yadi tāvat dvi aṇuka ādi dravyam prāk utpatteḥ atyantam eva asat utpannam ca sthitam kañcid kālam punar atyantam eva asat tvam āpadyate tathā ca sati asat eva sat jāyate sat eva asat tvam āpadyate abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ bhavati bhāvaḥ ca abhāvaḥ bhavati

original: tatra abhāvaḥ jāyamānaḥ prāk utpatteḥ śaśaviṣāṇakalpaḥ samavāyyasamavāyinimittākhyaṃ kāraṇam apekṣya jāyate iti. na ca evam, abhāvaḥ utpadyate, kāraṇaṃ ca apekṣate iti śakyaṃ vaktum, asatāṃ śaśaviṣāṇādīnām adarśanāt. bhāvātmakāścet ghaṭādayaḥ utpadyamānāḥ, kiñcit abhivyaktimātrekāraṇam apekṣya utpadyante iti śakyaṃ pratipattum.
analyzed: tatra abhāvaḥ jāyamānaḥ prāk utpatteḥ śaśa viṣāṇa kalpaḥ samavāyi asamavāyi nimitta ākhyam kāraṇam apekṣya jāyate iti na ca evam abhāvaḥ utpadyate kāraṇam ca apekṣate iti śakyam vaktum asatām śaśa viṣāṇa ādīnām adarśanāt bhāva ātmakāḥ ced ghaṭa ādayaḥ utpadyamānāḥ kiñcid abhivyakti mātrekāraṇam apekṣya utpadyante iti śakyam pratipattum

original: kiṃ ca, asataśca sataśca sadbhāve asadbhāve na kvacit pramāṇaprameyavyavahāreṣu viśvāsaḥ kasyacit syāt, 'sat sadeva asat asadeva' iti niścayānupapatteḥ.
analyzed: kim ca asataḥ ca sataḥ ca sadbhāve asadbhāve na kvacid pramāṇa prameya vyavahāreṣu viśvāsaḥ kasyacid syāt sat sat eva asat asat eva iti niścaya anupapatteḥ

original: kiṃ ca, utpadyate iti dvyaṇukādeḥ dravyasya svakāraṇasattāsaṃbandham āhuḥ. prāk utpatteśca asat, paścāt kāraṇavyāpāram apekṣya svakāraṇaiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ sattayā ca samavāyalakṣaṇena saṃbandhena saṃbadhyate. saṃbaddhaṃ sat kāraṇasamavetaṃ sat bhavati.
analyzed: kim ca utpadyate iti dvyaṇuka ādeḥ dravyasya sva kāraṇa sattā saṃbandham āhuḥ prāk utpatteḥ ca asat paścāt kāraṇa vyāpāram apekṣya sva kāraṇaiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ sattayā ca samavāya lakṣaṇena saṃbandhena saṃbadhyate saṃbaddham sat kāraṇa samavetam sat bhavati

original: tatra vaktavyaṃ katham asataḥ svaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavet saṃbandho vā kenacit syāt? na hi vandhyāputrasya svaṃ kāraṇaṃ saṃbandho vā kenacit pramāṇataḥ kalpayituṃ śakyate..
analyzed: tatra vaktavyam katham asataḥ svam kāraṇam bhavet saṃbandhaḥ vā kenacid syāt na hi vandhyā putrasya svam kāraṇam saṃbandhaḥ vā kenacid pramāṇataḥ kalpayitum śakyate

original: nanu naivaṃ vaiśeṣikaiḥ abhāvasya saṃbandhaḥ kalpyate. dvyaṇukādīnāṃ hi dravyāṇāṃ svakāraṇasamavāyalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ satāmeva ucyate iti. na; saṃbandhāt prāk sattvānabhyupagamāt. na hi vaiśeṣikaiḥ kulāladaṇḍacakrādivyāpārāt prāk ghaṭādīnām astitvam iṣyate. na ca mṛda eva ghaṭādyākāraprāptim icchanti.
analyzed: nanu nā evam vaiśeṣikaiḥ abhāvasya saṃbandhaḥ kalpyate dvyaṇuka ādīnām hi dravyāṇām sva kāraṇa samavāya lakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ satām eva ucyate iti na saṃbandhāt prāk sattva anabhyupagamāt na hi vaiśeṣikaiḥ kulāla daṇḍa cakra ādi vyāpārāt prāk ghaṭa ādīnām astitvam iṣyate na ca mṛdaḥ eva ghaṭa ādi ākāra prāptim icchanti

original: tataśca asata eva saṃbandhaḥ pāriśeṣyāt iṣṭo bhavati..
analyzed: tatas ca asataḥ eva saṃbandhaḥ pāriśeṣyāt iṣṭaḥ bhavati

original: nanu asato'pi samavāyalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ na viruddhaḥ. na; vandhyāputrādīnām adarśanāt. ghaṭādereva prāgabhāvasya svakāraṇasaṃbandho bhavati na vandhyāputrādeḥ, abhāvasya tulyatve'pi iti viśeṣaḥ abhāvasya vaktavyaḥ.
analyzed: nanu asataḥ api samavāya lakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ na viruddhaḥ na vandhyā putra ādīnām adarśanāt ghaṭa ādeḥ eva prāgabhāvasya sva kāraṇa saṃbandhaḥ bhavati na vandhyā putra ādeḥ abhāvasya tulya tve pi iti viśeṣaḥ abhāvasya vaktavyaḥ

original: ekasya abhāvaḥ, dvayoḥ abhāvaḥ, sarvasya abhāvaḥ, prāgabhāvaḥ, pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ, itaretarābhāvaḥ, atyantābhāvaḥ iti lakṣaṇato na kenacit viśeṣo darśayituṃ śakyaḥ.
analyzed: ekasya abhāvaḥ dvayoḥ abhāvaḥ sarvasya abhāvaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ itaretara abhāvaḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ iti lakṣaṇataḥ na kenacid viśeṣaḥ darśayitum śakyaḥ

original: asati ca viśeṣe ghaṭasya prāgabhāvaḥ eva kulāladibhiḥ ghaṭabhāvam āpadyate saṃbadhyate ca bhāvena kapālākhyena, saṃbaddhaśca sarvavyavahārayogyaśca bhavati, na tu ghaṭasyaiva pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ abhāvatve satyapi, iti pradhvaṃsādyabhāvānāṃ na kvacit vyavahārayogyatvam, prāgabhāvasyaiva dvyaṇukādidravyākhyasya utpattyādivyavahārārhatvam, ityetat
analyzed: asati ca viśeṣe ghaṭasya prāgabhāvaḥ eva kulāla ādibhiḥ ghaṭa bhāvam āpadyate saṃbadhyate ca bhāvena kapāla ākhyena saṃbaddhaḥ ca sarva vyavahāra yogyaḥ ca bhavati na tu ghaṭasya eva pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ abhāva tve sati api iti pradhvaṃsa ādi abhāvānām na kvacid vyavahāra yogya tvam prāgabhāvasya eva dvyaṇuka ādi dravya ākhyasya utpatti ādi vyavahāra arha tvam iti etat

original: asamañjasam; abhāvatvāviśeṣāt atyantapradhvaṃsābhāvayoriva..
analyzed: asamañjasam abhāva tva aviśeṣāt atyanta pradhvaṃsa abhāvayoḥ iva

original: nanu naiva asmābhiḥ prāgabhāvasya bhāvāpattiḥ ucyate. bhāvasyaiva tarhi bhāvāpattiḥ; yathā ghaṭasya ghaṭāpattiḥ, paṭasya vā paṭāpattiḥ. etadapi abhāvasya bhāvāpattivadeva pramāṇaviruddham. sāṃkhyasyāpi yaḥ pariṇāmapakṣaḥ so'pi apūrvadharmotpattivināśāṅagīkaraṇāt vaiśeṣikapakṣāt na viśiṣyate.
analyzed: nanu na eva asmābhiḥ prāgabhāvasya bhāva āpattiḥ ucyate bhāvasya eva tarhi bhāva āpattiḥ yathā ghaṭasya ghaṭa āpattiḥ paṭasya vā paṭa āpattiḥ etat api abhāvasya bhāva āpatti vat eva pramāṇa viruddham sāṃkhyasya api yaḥ pariṇāma pakṣaḥ saḥ api apūrva dharma utpatti vināśa aṅagīkaraṇāt vaiśeṣika pakṣāt na viśiṣyate

original: abhivyaktitirobhāvāṅagīkaraṇe'pi abhivyaktitirobhāvayoḥ vidyamānatvāvidyamānatvanirūpaṇe pūrvavadeva pramāṇavirodhaḥ. etena kāraṇasyaiva saṃsthānam utpattyādi ityetadapi pratyuktam..
analyzed: abhivyakti tirobhāva aṅagīkaraṇe api abhivyakti tirobhāvayoḥ vidyamāna tva avidyamāna tva nirūpaṇe pūrvavat eva pramāṇa virodhaḥ etena kāraṇasya eva saṃsthānam utpatti ādi iti etat api pratyuktam

original: pāriśeṣyāt sat ekameva vastu avidyayā utpattivināśādidharmaiḥ anekadhā naṭavat vikalpyate iti. idaṃ bhāgavataṃ matam uktam 'nāsato vidyate bhāvaḥ (gītā 3.16)' ityasmin śloke, satpratyayasya avyabhicārāt, vyabhicārācca itareṣāmiti..
analyzed: pāriśeṣyāt sat ekam eva vastu avidyayā utpatti vināśa ādi dharmaiḥ anekadhā naṭa vat vikalpyate iti idam bhāgavatam matam uktam na asataḥ vidyate bhāvaḥ gītā iti asmin śloke sat pratyayasya avyabhicārāt vyabhicārāt ca itareṣām iti

original: kathaṃ tarhi ātmanaḥ avikriyatve aśeṣataḥ karmaṇaḥ tyāgaḥ na upapadyate iti? yadi vastubhūtāḥ guṇāḥ, yadi vā avidyākalpitāḥ, taddharmaḥ karma, tadā ātmani avidyādhyāropitameva iti avidvān 'na hi kaścit kṣaṇamapi aśeṣataḥ tyaktuṃ śaknoti' iti uktam.
analyzed: katham tarhi ātmanaḥ avikriya tve aśeṣatas karmaṇaḥ tyāgaḥ na upapadyate iti yadi vastu bhūtāḥ guṇāḥ yadi vā avidyā kalpitāḥ tad dharmaḥ karma tadā ātmani avidyā adhyāropitam eva iti avidvān na hi kaścid kṣaṇam api aśeṣatas tyaktum śaknoti iti uktam

original: vidvāṃstu punaḥ vidyayā avidyāyāṃ nivṛttāyāṃ śaknotyeva aśeṣataḥ karma parityaktum, avidyādhyāropitasya śeṣānupapatteḥ. na hi taimirikadṛṣṭyā adhyāropitasya dvicandrādeḥ timirāpagame'pi śeṣaḥ avatiṣṭhate.
analyzed: vidvān tu punar vidyayā avidyāyām nivṛttāyām śaknoti eva aśeṣatas karma parityaktum avidyā adhyāropitasya śeṣa anupapatteḥ na hi taimirika dṛṣṭyā adhyāropitasya dvi candra ādeḥ timira apagame pi śeṣaḥ avatiṣṭhate

original: evaṃ ca sati idaṃ vacanam upapannam 'sarvakarmāṇi manasā (gītā 5.13)' ityādi, 'sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ (gītā 18.45)' 'svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya siddhiṃ
analyzed: evam ca sati idam vacanam upapannam sarva karmāṇi manasā gītā ityādi sve sve karmaṇi abhirataḥ saṃsiddhim labhate naraḥ gītā 1845 sva karmaṇā tam abhyarcya siddhim

original: vindati mānavaḥ (gītā 18.46)' iti ca..
analyzed: vindati mānavaḥ gītā 1846 iti ca

original: yā karmajā siddhiḥ uktā jñānaniṣṭhāyogyatālakṣaṇā, tasyāḥ phalabhūtā naiṣkarmyasiddhiḥ jñānaniṣṭhālakṣaṇā ca vaktavyeti ślokaḥ ārabhyate
analyzed: yā karma jā siddhiḥ uktā jñāna niṣṭhā yogyatā lakṣaṇā tasyāḥ phala bhūtā naiṣkarmya siddhiḥ jñāna niṣṭhā lakṣaṇā ca vaktavyā iti ślokaḥ ārabhyate

original: asaktabuddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigataspṛhaḥ.
analyzed: asakta buddhiḥ sarvatra jita ātmā vigata spṛhaḥ

original: naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ paramāṃ saṃnyāsenādhigacchati..18.49..
analyzed: naiṣkarmya siddhim paramām saṃnyāsena adhigacchati

original: asaktabuddhiḥ asaktā saṅagarahitā buddhiḥ antaḥkaraṇaṃ yasya saḥ asaktabuddhiḥ sarvatra putradārādiṣu āsaktinimitteṣu, jitātmā jitaḥ vaśīkṛtaḥ ātmā antaḥkaraṇaṃ yasya saḥ jitātmā, vigataspṛhaḥ vigatā spṛhā tṛṣṇā dehajīvitabhogeṣu yasmāt saḥ vigataspṛhaḥ, yaḥ evaṃbhūtaḥ ātmajñaḥ saḥ naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ nirgatāni karmāṇi yasmāt

original: yathā 'siṃho devadattaḥ' 'agnirmāṇavakaḥ' iti siṃha iva agniriva krauryapaiṅagalyādisāmānyavattvāt devadattamāṇavakādhikaraṇastutyarthameva, na tu siṃhakāryam agnikāryaṃ vā gauṇaśabdapratyayanimittaṃ kiñcitsādhyate; mithyāpratyayakāryaṃ tu anarthamanubhavati iti.

original: gauṇapratyayaviṣayaṃ jānāti 'naiṣa siṃhaḥ devadattaḥ', tathā 'nāyamagnirmāṇavakaḥ' iti. tathā gauṇena dehādisaṃghātena ātmanā kṛtaṃ karma na mukhyena ahaṃpratyayaviṣayeṇa ātmanā kṛtaṃ syāt. na hi gauṇasiṃhāgnibhyāṃ kṛtaṃ karma mukhyasiṃhāgnibhyāṃ kṛtaṃ syāt.
analyzed: gauṇa pratyaya viṣayam jānāti na eṣa siṃhaḥ devadattaḥ tathā na ayam agniḥ māṇavakaḥ iti tathā gauṇena deha ādi saṃghātena ātmanā kṛtam karma na mukhyena ahaṃpratyaya viṣayeṇa ātmanā kṛtam syāt na hi gauṇa siṃha agnibhyām kṛtam karma mukhya siṃha agnibhyām kṛtam syāt

original: na ca krauryeṇa paiṅagalyena vā mukhyasiṃhāgnyoḥ kāryaṃ kiñcit kriyate, stutyarthatvena upakṣīṇatvāt. stūyamānau ca jānītaḥ 'na ahaṃ siṃhaḥ' 'na aham agniḥ' iti; na hi 'siṃhasya karma mama agneśca' iti. tathā 'na saṃghātasya karma mama mukhyasya ātmanaḥ' iti pratyayaḥ yuktataraḥ syāt; na punaḥ 'ahaṃ kartā mama karma' iti.
analyzed: na ca krauryeṇa paiṅagalyena vā mukhya siṃha agnyoḥ kāryam kiñcid kriyate stuti artha tvena upakṣīṇa tvāt stūyamānau ca jānītaḥ na aham siṃhaḥ na aham agniḥ iti na hi siṃhasya karma mama agneḥ ca iti tathā na saṃghātasya karma mama mukhyasya ātmanaḥ iti pratyayaḥ yuktataraḥ syāt na punar aham kartā mama karma iti
